programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Smugglers, the police, locals and tourists get drawn into a dangerous web of survival, sacrifice and shifting loyalties as Europe faces a surge in migration.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: When a young boy mails his Christmas wish list to Santa with one crucial spelling error, a devilish Jack Black arrives to wreak havoc on the holidays.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: A buoy and a satellite meet online long after humanity's extinction. As they learn what life was like on Earth, they discover themselves and what it means to be alive and in love.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: A group of outlaws awaken to their empty train heist bag. Interrogations begin as each cowboy becomes the focus in an attempt to unmask the thief among them. Tensions mount as each bandit struggles to clear their name before bullets fly.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Three strong-willed women (Kristen Stewart, Laura Dern, Michelle Williams) strive to forge their own paths amidst the wide-open plains of the American Northwest.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Coerced into working for a crime boss, a talented getaway driver must face the music when a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Hoping to stay in the country, a gay man proposes a green card marriage to a female friend in exchange for paying for her IVF treatment. However, things get complicated when his grandmother surprises them with an extravagant Korean wedding banquet.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Indebted to a big-time drug lord, a pot dealer travels to Mexico with a fake family and a camper to pick up a large shipment and smuggle it into the U.S.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Comic misadventures follow when a rising executive (Paul Rudd) brings a blundering IRS agent (Steve Carell) to a monthly gathering hosted by his boss.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: After his girlfriend dies in an accident, a grieving man joins a sleep trial that allows him to rebuild his life with her through the use of lucid dreams.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Best friends Kate and Meg find themselves competing for the same man while waiting for their plane to take off from St. Louis.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Murders draw a young woman (Neve Campbell), a reporter (Courteney Cox Arquette) and an ex-policeman (David Arquette) to the set of a movie inspired by horrific events that they survived.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: The Ghostface Killer returns with a vengeance when self-help author Sidney Prescott arrives in Woodsboro on the last stop of her book tour.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Hoping to close a sale and save their jobs, two co-workers (Jason Bateman, T.J. Miller) must rally their colleagues to throw an epic Christmas party.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: A 12-year-old boy starts to see a shadowy figure in the woods after hearing a spooky story at summer camp.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: A former criminal gets blackmailed into one last job to collect a mysterious package. After a deadly double-cross, he soon finds himself wounded and on the run from ruthless assassins who will stop at nothing to get what he has.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: After a young man (Shawn Hatosy) crashes into a police cruiser, his father sends him to boarding school where he struggles to be accepted.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: A ne'er-do-well auto-parts heir must stop his father's widow from selling the business.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Given one last shot at glory, a former boxing champion has just six days to make weight for a title fight. His obsession soon leaves him at the mercy of a notorious trainer who takes every last ounce from his mind, body and soul.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: A beautiful Mexican-American singer's (Jennifer Lopez) skyrocketing international career ends abruptly.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Dark secrets intrude on the blossoming romance between a widowed merchant and a new arrival in a small North Carolina town.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Nicholas and Isabel are made for each other, but as destiny pulls them together, family, passion and faith drives them apart. As they embark on journeys of heartache and misplaced love, fate soon contrives to pull the threads of their lives together.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: An aspiring teenage rock journalist gets his big break when he follows an up-and-coming band on its tour.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: A call-girl helps a Princeton applicant turn his home into a one-night brothel.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Three friends try to recapture the fun of their college years by starting their own off-campus fraternity.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Two lovers (Willem Dafoe, Shanyn Leigh) immerse themselves in sex, art and other activities after word breaks that the world will end by the next morning.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: A soldier uses his military training to rescue the kidnapped daughter of his dead friend.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: A soldier (Ryan Phillippe) whose tour of duty has ended takes matters into his own hands when the Army tries to force him back into active duty in Iraq.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Author J.D. Salinger leads a reclusive lifestyle after the success of his popular and controversial novel The Catcher in the Rye.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Two buddies (Sean Penn, Nicolas Cage) with girlfriends hop trains for kicks before joining the Marines in 1942 California.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Gertrude Bell's life as an explorer, cartographer, and archaeologist for the British Empire.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Summoned home to visit her two sisters and her ailing father, a woman starts to re-evaluate her life as she wonders what could have been.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: The interlocking stories of two young Oglala Lakota men grappling with a world built against them as they navigate their unique paths to manhood.

programme.title: Scotland: Rome's Final Frontier

programme.title: Stephen Sondheim's Old Friends

He had specially devised it to celebrate Stephen's extraordinary talents as a composer and lyricist. Featuring Michael Ball, Helena Bonham Carter, Rob Brydon, Petula Clark, Anna-Jane Casey, Rosalie Craig, Janie Dee, Judi Dench, Daniel Evans, Maria Friedman, Haydn Gwynne, Bonnie Langford, Damian Lewis and Julia McKenzie.

programme.title: Sondheim at the BBC
programme.desc: A celebration of the work of one of the great songwriters and lyricists, Stephen Sondheim, who passed away in November 2021 at the age of 91. A giant of musical theatre, Sondheim first found international fame in 1957 as the lyricist for Leonard Bernstein's 'West Side Story'.

programme.desc: S1 E29 — Trapped!An impatient Great Gnanna gets accidentally trapped with Gadabout in the dispensary. It's a tense time for both of them, while Zog and Pearl race to set them free.

programme.title: Balamory
programme.desc: S2 E2 — ExplorersMiss Hoolie and the children are set for a woodland trip, but the wind tears Ollie's map.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: S2 E2 — Waffle Is UnwellWaffle is unwell. He's in his pyjamas and under strict orders to stay in bed and rest. But poor Waffle can't get comfy. When he sees Evie and Simon playing in the garden, he feels left out and begins to woof and woof. Simon tells Waffle to rest quietly, but it's too late. The wonder dog's incessant barking has already disturbed Mrs Hobbs next door and, to make matters worse, like Waffle she's not feeling well either.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: S1 E32 — The Big Baby WishRafi wishes Oscar was bigger so they can play together, but he turns into a giant baby!

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: S1 E29 — Autumn: It's Time to Harvest VegetablesJoJo and Gran Gran are making Great Gran Gran's St Lucian Callaloo soup, but they can't buy the last few vegetables they need because Jared's shop is closed. Luckily, Gran Gran has a Gran Gran Plan to harvest her own vegetables from the allotment.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: S1 E25 — Pipe ConductorSarah and Duck are woken up by a loud clanging overhead and decide to investigate the noise.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: S2 E16 — The Moo FlowerTiny and Small are fishing in the music boat when they see a sticky green pod stuck to a skymoo's snout. They take it home with them, and it turns out to be a surprising seed.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: S1 E2 — HugMeMo and BaBa play with a cuddly teddy bear and all their BeddyByes friends. They discover that when you are feeling sad, sometimes all you need is a hug to make things better.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: S2 E14 — Trousers on the Ninky NonkThe Tombliboos forget their trousers, and have to go home without them, but here comes Makka Pakka, and he's got a present for the Tombliboos.

programme.title: Cbeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: S2026 — New and Trending:06/04/2026A different story read each night just before bedtime.

programme.title: Earth's Natural Wonders
programme.desc: S2 E2 — Surviving with AnimalsIn many of the world's most extraordinary natural wonders there is an abundance of animals. These can be a devastating threat to the people who live there, or they can provide a means of survival, but often at a high price.

programme.title: To the Manor Born
programme.desc: S3 E5 — CosmeticsDeVere negotiates an important business deal with the beautiful Mademoiselle Dutoit, but when she decides to mix business with pleasure, he invents a wife... Audrey!

programme.title: Keeping Up Appearances
programme.desc: S5 E9 — The Rolls RoyceWhen Hyacinth decides that a new car is in order, she aims rather higher than most people - much to Richard's horror.

programme.title: The Stuarts
programme.desc: S1 E3 — A Family At WarAfter Charles II's brother, the Catholic James VII & II, was deposed by protestant William of Orange in 1688, Britain became a constitutional monarchy. But the so-called 1688 'Glorious Revolution' came at a price.

programme.title: The Longest Goodbye
programme.desc: NASA intends to send astronauts to Mars. To succeed, crew members will have to overcome unprecedented, life-threatening challenges, and while many of these hazards are physical, the most elusive are psychological. Throughout the expected three-year absence, crew members won't be able to communicate with Earth in real time due to the immense distance.

programme.title: Colour: The Spectrum of Science
programme.desc: S1 E2 — Colours of LifeThe raw, early Earth had plenty of colour, but that was nothing compared with what was going to come next. That canvas was about to be painted with a vast new palette - and the source of those colours was life.

So they decide to sell him, and after a nice lady buys his stacky bit for her toilet rolls, they look for some more things to sell. But then they find Mr Rainbow's head and are sad that they can't get the rest of him back. However, Charlie loves to knock down Mr Rainbow's rings.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops

programme.title: Hey Duggee

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S5 E2 — The Face Painting BadgeThe Squirrels search for Duggee. They find someone who looks like Enid, but larger. It is Duggee with his face painted to resemble Enid. Fascinated, the Squirrels ask Duggee to paint their faces too.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S3 E14 — Pass the ParcelLucky's Dad is outraged that modern Pass the Parcel has a present in every layer and changes the rules back to only having one prize in the middle. As a result, Bingo is forever losing.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S2 E2 — HammerbarnThe Heelers go on a fun trip to Hammerbarn to get a new pizza oven like their neighbours'. At Hammerbarn, Bluey and Bingo play in the gardening section and set up mini-gardens in the trolley.

programme.title: Go Jetters Go!
programme.desc: S1 E8 — Salar de Uyuni, BoliviaKym and Lars go to the mysterious salt flats of Bolivia to solve Ubercorn's tricky clues.

programme.title: Playtime Towers
programme.desc: S3 E3 — KiteBella and Lift play with kites in Playtime Towers.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Top of the Pups: Bath TimeMrs Weaver sings a song about how much fun bath time is.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: S2 E21 — Helping HoppityBing, Hoppity, his friends and their toys are playing superheroes in the park. When Bing and Hoppity rescue Flop from the giant spider, Bing falls off the climbing rope. He is all right, but Hoppity has had an accident: his bottom is broken! Sula, Pando and Flop help an upset Bing rescue Hoppity and then take him to Amma's, where she can sew him back together.

programme.title: Yakka Dee
programme.desc: S3 E6 — CoatDee encourages a friend to say 'coat' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see various types of coats, from a raincoat to a snowy coat and even a glowy coat. We see a dinosaur coat and a dog in a coat.

programme.title: Tralala
programme.desc: S1 E13 — Water ColoursTralala is painting in the garden when she finds a lost little cloud who needs caring for.

programme.title: MaeBee

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: S2 E19 — Our Wonderful FriendKiri makes an embarrassing mistake and learns to laugh about it.

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: S3 E5 — More About RollingThe Twirlywoos are watching a man put up a poster on a billboard, by unrolling strips of the poster and pasting them on the board. The Twirlywoos help the man by rolling the strips of the poster out of the van.

programme.title: Something Special

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: S2 E45 — SongtimeTinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po enjoy Tiddlytubbies Songtime. Then it is time for Teletubbies Songtime. The Teletubbies sing solo before singing all together.

programme.title: I Spy, You Spy

programme.title: Maddie and Triggs
programme.desc: S1 E28 — Muddy BootsMaddie and Triggs buddy up to lead a family walk that is full of music, mud, and mayhem.

programme.title: Monster Makes

Although he's disappointed, it gives Murphy an idea - a clothes peg giraffe. The Mini Monsters are using everyday things to create great makes, and a call comes in on the Magic Monster Mirror from Rebecca's aunt. Murphy's mega monster make is a fun woolly head game, inspired by scraps of wool delivered by the Recycling Express.

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion
programme.desc: S3 E3 — Raa Raa and the JunglephoneWhen their jungle phone breaks, Raa Raa and Ooo Ooo lose contact and Raa Raa thinks Ooo Ooo doesn't want to be friends any more. Luckily Topsy is able to help them find each other again.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S1 E1 — The Magic XylophoneBluey and Bingo have a magic xylophone that can freeze Dad in space and time. However, Dad gains control and freezes Bluey instead.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S3 E37 — The Buddy BadgeDuggee hosts a Buddy Bonanza for Mrs Weaver and the Squirrels, with the aim of finding new buddies with common interests to them.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures

programme.title: Our Family

Dr Amit and Kika have an important mission to pick up a surprise cake and some party hats from the supermarket for Aunty Nina's birthday.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Chihuahua
programme.desc: A pampered pet dog gets separated from her owner, and is left stranded in Mexico struggling to avoid a dognapper and a ferocious Doberman, who are after her diamond collar. Luckily, a courageous German shepherd is on hand to help her get back home. Comedy, starring Piper Perabo and Jamie Lee Curtis, with the voices of Drew Barrymore and Andy Garcia.

programme.title: Brave
programme.desc: A princess defies her mother's plans to secure peace by marrying her off to the son of one of their allies. A witch provides the rebellious royal with a magic spell to change her fate, but the enchantment backfires disastrously when the queen is transformed into a bear. Pixar's animated fantasy, with the voices of Kelly Macdonald, Emma Thompson and Billy Connolly.

programme.title: Percy Jackson & the Lightning Thief
programme.desc: A teenager is shocked to discover he is the son of Greek god Poseidon and has been accused of stealing Zeus's lightning bolt. The youngster is given 14 days to find the culprit and return the missing item before the furious deity instigates an apocalyptic war. Fantasy adventure, starring Logan Lerman, Pierce Brosnan, Brandon T Jackson, Alexandra Daddario, Jake Abel, Sean Bean and Steve Coogan.

programme.title: Lilo & Stitch
programme.desc: A lonely little girl befriends a runaway alien that helps mend her fractured family. Live action fantasy adventure, starring Maia Kealoha and Sydney Agudong.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast
programme.desc: A prince is transformed into a hideous monster as punishment for his selfishness, and can only regain his human form by finding true love. Salvation comes in the form of a spirited village girl, who offers to take her father's place when he is imprisoned in the monster's castle. But as romance blossoms between the unlikely pair, a jealous rival suitor only sees a beast to be slain. Live-action remake of the Disney animated fairy tale, starring Emma Watson, Dan Stevens and Luke Evans, with Ewan McGregor, Emma Thompson and Ian McKellen playing the Beast's entourage of living ornaments.

programme.title: Ralph Breaks the Internet
programme.desc: Six years after the events of Wreck-It Ralph, the destructive video game character and his hyperactive friend Vanellope discover a wi-fi router in Litwak's Family Fun Centre and Arcade. Before long, they embark on a new quest involving Disney princesses, and a few familar faces. Animated adventure, with the voices of John C Reilly, Sarah Silverman and Gal Gadot.

programme.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
programme.desc: A boy abducted by aliens grows up to be an interstellar mercenary. He and a band of misfits break out of a prison space station with a plan to sell a mysterious orb to the highest bidder - but cross a warlord, who intends to turn it into a powerful weapon. Sci-fi adventure, starring Chris Pratt, Zoe Saldana and Dave Bautista, with the voices of Bradley Cooper and Vin Diesel.

programme.title: Solo: A Star Wars Story
programme.desc: Amid emerging demand for hyperfuel and other resources, a headstrong pilot gets mixed up with a bunch of mercenaries, a militant robot, a gambler and a Wookie while attempting to appease a crime lord in an adventure that exposes an underworld's seedy belly. Sci-fi prequel set before the events of Star Wars: A New Hope, starring Alden Ehrenreich, Emilia Clarke, Woody Harrelson, Donald Glover and Paul Bettany.

programme.title: Tron: Legacy
programme.desc: Ground-breaking computer genius Kevin Flynn disappears without trace. Years later, his son Sam goes looking for him, and is transported into a computer-generated world where he is forced to compete in deadly gladiatorial combat by an evil duplicate of his father plotting to wage war on the real world. Sci-fi adventure, with Jeff Bridges and Garrett Hedlund.

programme.title: The Amateur
programme.desc: When his supervisors at the CIA refuse to take action after his wife is killed in a London terrorist attack, a cryptographer takes matters into his own hands. Thriller, starring Rami Malek, Laurence Fishburne, Rachel Brosnahan and Jon Bernthal.

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: Underwater princess Ariel becomes bored with her aquatic existence and spends her time spying on humans, much to the annoyance of her father. Longing to live on land, she strikes a deal with a banished sea witch in order to become human and meet a prince - but there is a price to be paid. Disney's animated adventure, with the voices of Jodi Benson, Christopher Daniel Barnes and Rene Auberjonois.

programme.title: Treasure Planet
programme.desc: A rebellious teenager obtains a map leading to the planet where a notorious space pirate hid his treasure. Joining a spaceship crew, he embarks on a perilous journey in search of the loot - unaware that the vessel's cyborg cook is planning a mutiny. Animated sci-fi adventure based on the plot of Treasure Island, with the voices of Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Brian Murray and Emma Thompson.

programme.title: Planes
programme.desc: A crop duster longs to be a racing plane, but is hamstrung by a fear of heights. With the aid of a veteran flyer, he learns to conquer his phobia and compete against some of the world's greatest flyers in a round-the-world race. Animated adventure spin-off from Pixar's Cars, with the voices of Dane Cook, Teri Hatcher and Stacy Keach.

programme.title: Frankenweenie
programme.desc: A lonely boy uses electricity to bring his dead dog back to life. However, the presence of the animal in the neighbourhood leads to panic over a monster, while the young scientist's classmates are soon also meddling with life and death to revive their own pets. Tim Burton's stop-motion animated fantasy, with the voices of Charlie Tahan and Winona Ryder.

programme.title: Brave
programme.desc: A princess defies her mother's plans to secure peace by marrying her off to the son of one of their allies. A witch provides the rebellious royal with a magic spell to change her fate, but the enchantment backfires disastrously when the queen is transformed into a bear. Pixar's animated fantasy, with the voices of Kelly Macdonald, Emma Thompson and Billy Connolly.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian
programme.desc: The four Pevensie children are summoned back to the magical land of Narnia to find centuries have passed in their absence. War is now brewing, and the young heroes must help Prince Caspian, the rightful king of Narnia, to overthrow his cruel uncle and reclaim the throne. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Ben Barnes, William Moseley, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell and Peter Dinklage.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Voyage of the Dawn Treader
programme.desc: Lucy and Edmund Pevensie return to the magical world accompanied by their selfish cousin. They join their old friend King Caspian as he sets sail across the sea in search of seven of his father's allies who had been banished years before, but along the way they discover an evil force is growing in strength. Fantasy adventure, with Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Will Poulter and Ben Barnes.

programme.title: The Princess and the Frog
programme.desc: A hard-working New Orleans waitress meets an arrogant prince who has been turned into a frog by a magic spell. When she tries to break the enchantment by kissing him, she also ends up transformed into an amphibian, and together they go in search of the voodoo queen who can change them back. Disney animated musical fantasy, with the voices of Anika Noni Rose and Bruno Campos.

programme.title: Inspector Gadget
programme.desc: A clumsy security guard is critically injured during a run-in with a thief, so his cybernetics-expert employer transforms him into the ultimate crime-fighting machine - a bionic officer with an array of gadgets and weaponry cunningly concealed inside his body. Comedy adventure based on the 1980s cartoon series, starring Matthew Broderick, Rupert Everett and Joely Fisher.

programme.title: The Life Aquatic with Steve Zissou
programme.desc: An eccentric marine expert sets out in search of a legendary shark that ate his old friend and shipmate. Unfortunately the voyage is riddled with problems, including a man claiming to be his long-lost son, a pursuing pirate crew and a rival oceanographer. Wes Anderson's comedy drama, starring Bill Murray, Owen Wilson, Cate Blanchett, Willem Dafoe and Jeff Goldblum.

programme.title: Starship Troopers
programme.desc: Courageous military recruits hurl themselves into a desperate war against alien insects set on destroying mankind. They blast off for the creatures' home planet in a last-ditch attempt to save the human race from annihilation - little realising the carnage that awaits them. Sci-fi adventure from director Paul Verhoeven, starring Casper Van Dien, Denise Richards and Dina Meyer.

programme.title: Thor
programme.desc: The Norse god of thunder is banished from his own world when his arrogance puts the kingdom on the brink of war. He is sent to present-day Earth, where he is forced to live among humans without his supernatural powers, but must regain his abilities to defend his new home against his evil brother. Kenneth Branagh's fantasy adventure based on the Marvel comics, starring Chris Hemsworth, Natalie Portman, Tom Hiddleston and Anthony Hopkins.

programme.title: Victor Frankenstein
programme.desc: A sideshow performer is taken in by a scientist, who seeks his help in performing experiments to create life, and hopefully uncover the secrets of immortality. The plan goes dangerously out of control, and it falls to the devoted assistant to save his master from his dark obsessions and his monstrous creation. Gothic horror, starring James McAvoy and Daniel Radcliffe.

programme.title: Joy
programme.desc: An imaginative youngster with dreams of being an inventor grows up to be a downtrodden single mother, struggling to support her chaotic family. She sees a chance to turn all their lives around when inspiration strikes and she creates a new household tool, but faces the challenge of selling her product in the demanding world of a home shopping TV station. Fact-based drama, starring Jennifer Lawrence, Robert De Niro and Bradley Cooper.

programme.title: Prometheus
programme.desc: A spacecraft is sent to another world, following clues left in ancient artefacts, in search of aliens that may have created the human race. However, the explorers on board discover the extraterrestrials may not be the benevolent creatures they imagined, while the company funding the expedition has its own agenda. Ridley Scott's sci-fi thriller and Alien prequel, starring Noomi Rapace, Michael Fassbender, Charlize Theron and Idris Elba.

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: Underwater princess Ariel becomes bored with her aquatic existence and spends her time spying on humans, much to the annoyance of her father. Longing to live on land, she strikes a deal with a banished sea witch in order to become human and meet a prince - but there is a price to be paid. Disney's animated adventure, with the voices of Jodi Benson, Christopher Daniel Barnes and Rene Auberjonois.

programme.title: Peter Pan
programme.desc: The adventures of the boy who never grows old, as he whisks Wendy Darling and her brothers away to the magical world of Neverland - where they come face to face with fearsome Captain Hook. Adaptation of JM Barrie's fantasy novel, starring Jeremy Sumpter, Rachel Hurd-Wood, Jason Isaacs and Lynn Redgrave.

programme.title: Elio
programme.desc: Elio, a misfit kid, is mistaken for Earth's ambassador in space and bonds with aliens while discovering his true self. Pixar animation, with the voice of Yonas Kibreab.

programme.title: The Princess and the Frog
programme.desc: A hard-working New Orleans waitress meets an arrogant prince who has been turned into a frog by a magic spell. When she tries to break the enchantment by kissing him, she also ends up transformed into an amphibian, and together they go in search of the voodoo queen who can change them back. Disney animated musical fantasy, with the voices of Anika Noni Rose and Bruno Campos.

programme.title: Planes
programme.desc: A crop duster longs to be a racing plane, but is hamstrung by a fear of heights. With the aid of a veteran flyer, he learns to conquer his phobia and compete against some of the world's greatest flyers in a round-the-world race. Animated adventure spin-off from Pixar's Cars, with the voices of Dane Cook, Teri Hatcher and Stacy Keach.

programme.title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
programme.desc: A deformed bell-ringer living reclusively in a cathedral in the heart of medieval Paris is tempted out of seclusion when a gypsy festival arrives and captures his imagination. Here in the outside world, he learns the cruel government minister who raised him is hatching a plan to wipe out the gypsies, so he resolves to protect his new friends. Disney animation, with the voices of Tom Hulce, Demi Moore and Kevin Kline.

programme.desc: Tara (Debby Ryan) - a painfully shy high-schooler, has a secret: she is also a confident DJ known as Radio Rebel, who lends her voice to others.

programme.desc: After a wealthy celebrity falls in love with a mystery woman at his Christmas masquerade ball, he attempts to discover her true identity.

programme.desc: A young events planner meets a stubborn web designer.

programme.desc: E3Focusing on the fanatical women who took Hitler under their wing and, through love and devotion, acclimatised him to high society to launch him to power, only to be left behind once he achieved it.

programme.title: Hitler's Handmaidens
programme.desc: E4Cataloguing the many lovers of the Nazi dictator, and charting the unfortunate demise of all who dared resist his love, affection and sexual appetite.

programme.title: Hitler's Secret Bomb
programme.desc: E2Did Nazi uranium make it to Japan in the final months of WW2? Were the Axis powers closer to a bomb than we think? Drama unfolds as experts shed new light on the hardships, challenges and secrets of a war-torn, pre-nuclear world.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E1The Grumman Avenger, which was the most important carrier-based torpedo bomber on American and British carriers throughout the Second World War. They were also the biggest and heaviest carrier aircraft of the conflict.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E2The Junkers Ju 52, which is considered one of the most famous airplanes in history. It was first designed as an airliner, but was used as a transport, bomber, and air ambulance during the Second World War.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E7True predators of the skies, the F-16 and the MiG-29 were created to fight each other, based on radically different design philosophies.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E5John F Kennedy first made news in 1943 when, as a skipper of a torpedo boat in the Pacific, he and his crew were shipwrecked. We tell the story of their rescue.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E6We explore two submarines – former Cold War enemies now moored in a Kent river, and discover the story of Vasili Arkhipov, a Soviet submariner who refused to authorise a nuclear launch.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: E5Vera finds out her agents' fate. Her beliefs about Noor are challenged. Suspicions lead Vera to hunt down a Nazi mastermind.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: E6Capture of a key Nazi uncovers shocking realities. Amid demands for accountability, as Vera and her team navigate murky waters to confront uncomfortable truths.

programme.title: Battle Treasures With Foxy And Bruce
programme.desc: E3Ordinary objects can become extraordinary when pulled from the battlefield. In this episode, Jason and Bruce explore a regimental band cornet, owned by a band member who tragically died during the infamous Battle of Isandlwana.

programme.title: Battle Treasures With Foxy And Bruce
programme.desc: E4Escape and survival in war often came down to ingenuity and courage. Jason and Bruce showcase miniature escape compasses, cunningly disguised inside RAF tunic buttons and belt buckles to help downed airmen find their way home.

programme.title: How To Lose A War
programme.desc: E2Exploring how the seeds of Japan's defeat in 1945 were sown a decade earlier with the occupation of Manchuria in China.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E5The Heinkel He 111 is one of the most recognised German aircraft of WW2. The broad winged design was a guinea pig for future bombers, with more variants than any other military aircraft of the time.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E6We trace the astonishing story of designers turning away from metal and back to wood to create a twin-engine bomber that could outrun almost any aircraft in the sky, yet deliver a bomb load greater than an Avro Lancaster.

programme.title: Combat Machines
programme.desc: E5Exploring the machines that hide in the shadows, capturing, transmitting and analysing vital combat information.

programme.title: Combat Machines
programme.desc: E6In 1961, Soviet T-54 tanks and American M-48 Patton tanks face off at Checkpoint Charlie in Berlin.

programme.title: Battle Treasures With Foxy And Bruce
programme.desc: E5This episode celebrates the bravery and innovation of those who took to the skies. Jason and Bruce explore the Caterpillar Club badge, awarded to aircrew who survived by parachuting from stricken aircraft.

programme.title: Battle Treasures With Foxy And Bruce
programme.desc: E6The shadowy world of special operations is brought vividly to life in this episode. Jason and Bruce handle Rusty Firmin’s SAS respirator, worn during the dramatic Iranian Embassy Siege of 1980.

programme.title: How To Lose A War
programme.desc: E3Exploring how the Axis Powers' ruthless, brutal occupation, and exploitation of other countries contributed to their demise.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: E5The war enters its third year with battlefields in Eastern Europe, North Africa and the Asia/Pacific. The Battle of Midway, a battle with irreversible consequences, is a victory for the USA.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: E6From the Indian border in Burma to China, which has been at war with Japan since 1937, the war grows more savage. In Europe, despite having less resources than when he first made the attempt, Hitler renews his assault on the Soviet Union.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: E4After Pearl Harbour and their triumphant sweep across South-East Asia, Japanese armies celebrate their victory. But Japanese confidence is shaken four months later at the Battle of the Coral Sea.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E3The Republic P-47 Thunderbolt, a Second World War fighter aircraft produced by the American company Republic Aviation from 1941 until 1945. It was considered a successful high-altitude fighter and also served as the foremost US fighter-bomber in the ground-attack role.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E4The Yakovlev Yak-3, a Second World War Soviet fighter that was regarded for its performance at low altitudes and its agility. It was one of the most successful Soviet aircraft designs of the war.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E8The Leopard 2 is probably the best all-around Main Battle Tank today, combining great mobility, a superior gun and excellent protection.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E7We tell the story of two rescues that ended in tragedy – the sinking of the hospital ship Britannic, and the Lancastria, rescuing soldiers and civilians from France in 1940. In the 19th century, USS Constellation chased down slave ships.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E8Ships don't have to be large to change the course of history. The Smithsonian has a small 1776 wooden gunboat, built to stop a British invasion and two Japanese midget submarines were part of the attack on Pearl Harbour.

programme.title: World War Weird
programme.desc: E1Near the Czech border, a secret German site, "The Giant," tests The Bell, powered by Serum 525, turning all who touch it into rotting living zombies.

programme.title: World War Weird
programme.desc: E21942 and Hitler has the totally barking idea of using educated dogs to do a soldier's job. The Nazi leader wants to create fearsome canines to help him win the Second World War.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: E1During WWII, the French Resistance seeks aid from SOE. Led by Vera Atkins, Odette Sansom and Noor Inayat Khan fight the Nazis, risking it all for victory.

Familjen undrar hur en lanthandel bedrevs förr, i synnerhet under ransoneringstid, och vilka som bott i huset? Antikexperten Rickard Thunér gräver i historien och upptäcker att huset förr gick under ett numera bortglömt namn. När Pers karriär efter Gyllene Tider börjar dala börjar Maries solostjärna stiga - och mot alla odds gör de en låt tillsammans som faktiskt blir en hit: Neverending Love 1986. Genom deras egna filmer får vi följa med från första singeln fram till att deras stora genombrott med The Look står för dörren.

programme.desc: Lena Anderssons Augustprisnominerade berättelse bjuder på både humor och skärpa. Här som pjäs på Kulturhuset Stockholms Stadsteater. Vi träffar besserwissern, paragrafryttaren, neurotikern, ensamvargen och flera i välbekanta och prekära situationer. Och det gäller att lyssna noga och försöka förstå också det som inte sägs. programme.title: Mördarens son
programme.desc: När Tabaré var tre år dömdes hans föräldrar för ett dubbelmord i Malmö och han placerades i familjehem. Efter att själv suttit i fängelse söker han, känd idag som boxaren och artisten Rankz, sanningen om sin fosterhemsplacering och hur det påverkat hans liv som präglats av droger och brott. Kan han bryta ett arv av kriminalitet och trauman samtidigt som hans frigivna pappa återvänder och en nära vän mördas? Svensk dokumentär från 2026 av Sebastian Peña Rojas och Jesper Klemedsson Sotomayor.

programme.title: Bardot
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Avsnitt 1Brigitte Bardot (1934-2025) var en av 1900-talets mest berömda filmstjärnor. Men bakom glamouren och berömmelsen fanns ett liv präglat av stormiga kärleksaffärer, filmskapare som exploaterade hennes privatliv samt en skoningslös press. 1973 lämnade hon plötsligt strålkastarljuset för att i stället ägna sitt liv åt kampen för djurens rättigheter och miljön. På senare år blev hon omstridd efter upprepade rasistiska uttalanden. I sitt sista framträdande framför kameran delar hon med sig av sin personliga berättelse om livet och drivkrafterna bakom sina livsval. Med personliga intervjuer, unikt arkivmaterial och exklusiva bilder från hennes privata egendom La Madrague tecknas ett nära porträtt av kvinnan bakom den mytomspunna stjärnan.

programme.title: Älvar

programme.title: Hundra procent bonde
programme.desc: S35 E5 — Nettle Sauce and Clay OvenFör första gången i Kastanjegårdens historia använder Frank en spruta i köksträdgården för att bekämpa fjärilslarver och annan ohyra. Ett nässelutdrag blir en illaluktande blandning - men det fungerar. En koreansk lerugn ska byggas, lökskörden beundras och franska skruvar monteras i kvarnstocken.

programme.title: Drömlandet
programme.desc: S2 E3 — Avsnitt 3Carina Bergfeldt och Farah Abadis resa genom Australien går vidare. På väg till Brisbane råkar de ut för problem men en räddare i nöden dyker upp. Väl framme i Brisbane träffar Farah människor som flyttat till landet i jakt på ett bättre liv, men såren från hemlandet visar sig vara svåra att läka. Carina och Farah åker vidare mot den mytomspunna outbacken som täcker större delen av landets yta. Där träffar de äventyraren Charlie och hans fru Deborah och tillsammans övernattar de ute i den röda öknen under bar himmel.

programme.title: Jakttid
programme.desc: S9 E10 — RevanschandaMilla och Samuli hoppas på bättre jaktlycka under en ny dag i vildmarken. Aki får sällskap av dottern Adela på en fisketur, Manu satsar på ett nytt projekt och Mehtämikko återvänder till norra Sverige för att lyckas med det som gick fel förra året.

programme.title: Världens natur: Kingdom
programme.desc: S1 E4 — Krokodilens listDen skadade vildhunden Flint är helt beroende av sin flock, men visar sig också vara ovärderlig för Storms största valpkull hittills. Samtidigt hårdnar kampen mellan leoparderna: Olimba kämpar för att behålla sitt revir medan dottern Mutima letar efter ett eget hem. Hyenorna återförenas och lejonflocken växer sig starkare, tills naturens krafter, inte rivalerna, plötsligt hotar att rubba hela maktordningen.

programme.title: Hem till bondgården
programme.desc: S1 E2 — Restaurering och reflektionFrån skådespelare och storstadsliv till småbarnsfamiljeliv på en stor bondgård. Kelvin och Liz byter röda mattan mot röd traktor när de satsar allt på en för dem mer meningsfull tillvaro i sin version av det enkla livet på landet. Det är inte så lätt alla gånger med fyra barn att ta hand om jämte djuren och den enorma gården. Men det är deras dröm och den är sann. Här får vi se glimtar av deras vedermödor på gården.

programme.title: Babel
programme.desc: S44 E9 — Isabella Nilsson och författarpanelen får ett uppdragFörfattaren och översättaren Isabella Nilsson debuterade med ungdomsromanen Verklighetsprojektet, och slog igenom med essäromanen Nonsensprinsessans dagbok. En sjukskrivning, som nominerades till Nordiska rådets litteraturpris. Nu kommer hennes nionde bok "Om varmhållning av levande döda" - elva texter med teman som ensamhet och skrivande. Författarpanelen med Jonathan Brott, Aris Fioretos och Maria Maunsbach får i uppgift att rekommendera böcker åt varandra och i förlängningen också åt tittarna. Programledare: Jessika Gedin.

programme.title: 40 år med CI - Vad säger forskarna?
programme.desc: Cochleaimplantat, CI, är ett hörselhjälpmedel som varje år opereras in på cirka 70 barn och 200 vuxna i Sverige. Läkare, pedagoger, psykologer och andra experter med olika perspektiv får svara på frågor om språkutvecklingen hos barn som får CI samt vad man idag vet om deras mående under uppväxten. Vi belyser även hur det fungerar att använda både talad svenska och svenskt teckenspråk, liksom hur skolan kan möta barnens olika behov. I programmet diskuteras också om flera äldre personer med grav hörselnedsättning än idag skulle kunna vara hjälpta av ett CI, men att många inte känner till möjligheten. Gäster i programmet är bland andra; Eva Karltorp, överläkare hörselimplantatmottagningen på Karolinska sjukhuset, Moa Gärdenfors, språkforskare vid Stockholms universitet och Anna Persson, specialpedagog och forskare, Karolinska Institutet. Programledare: Matilda Bergman Bergkrantz.

programme.title: Yellowstone
programme.desc: S3 E4 — Going Back to CaliEtt motorcykelgäng provocerar familjen Dutton. Beth trappar upp sin kamp mot den nya motståndaren som vill ta över marken, och John tar hjälp av guvernör Perry.

programme.desc: S6 E5 — Mördare inför rätta - Avsnitt 5, Säsong 6När rapartisten Martell DeRouen, känd som Kardone, inte hör av sig gör polisen en fasansfull upptäckt i hans lägenhet. Utredningen granskar hans liv, relationer och ett mystiskt larmsamtal dagarna före dådet.

programme.title: Polisens biljakter

programme.title: Brynolf & Ljung - Street magic

programme.title: Räkhäst - I huvudet på Per Andersson
programme.desc: Per Andersson har som en av Sveriges mest älskade och energiska komiker synts i TV-program som Grotesco och Parlamentet och stora scenproduktioner som Book of Mormon och ART. I Räkhäst kastas vi rakt in i Pers tankevärld och slängs mellan galna karaktärer, sketcher, kupletter och vilda infall genom en förstklassig humorkavalkad.

programme.title: Grand Slam 75
programme.desc: S2026 E38 — MantorpDirektsänd Grand Slam 75-omgång från Mantorp Hästsportarena.

programme.desc:
S3 E11 — 112 - på liv och död specialBrandmannen Micke och hans kollegor åker på ett akut larm för att göra hjärt- och lungräddning på en man som har drabbats av hjärtstillestånd. Några få sekunder kan utgöra skillnaden mellan liv och död för mannen. 

Magnus är ordningspolis i Gävle och arbetar för att hålla ordning på stadens gator och torg. Han får veta att ett slagsmål pågår på centralstationen. Han beger sig dit för att avstyra bråket.

Ambulanssjuksköterskorna Calle och Christoffer får larm om att en man misstänks ha drabbats av en stroke.

programme.title: 112 - på liv och död
programme.desc:

På ambulansenheten i Göteborg beger sig Anna i väg för att hjälpa en kvinna med svåra magsmärtor.

På Brännkyrka brandstation i Stockholm jobbar Micke natt. Under småtimmarna kommer ett larm om en lägenhetsbrand och brandmännen rycker ut.

Men på andra sidan Atlanten sitter Danmarks ambassadör i Amerika, våghalsen och världsmannen Henrik Kauffmann, som är beredd att sätta allt på ett kort. Han vägrar att följa de tyska kraven och verkställer istället en rebellisk plan för att besegra Hitler och frige den danska befolkningen.

programme.title: Im Königreich der Erdäpfel
programme.desc: Seit Kaiserin Maria Theresia im 18. Jahrhundert den Anbau gegen Hungersnöte verordnete, prägen Erdäpfel das österreichische Waldviertel. Regionale Fachleute zeigen heute Kultivierung und Rezepte.

programme.title: Der Biss der Erkenntnis - Geschichten vom Apfel
programme.desc: Der Apfel gilt als Frucht der Unsterblichkeit, Verführung, Liebe und Erotik. Der Film erzählt Geschichten rund um den Apfel und folgt seinen historischen und kulturgeschichtlichen Spuren.Wie Wein, Brot und Öl ist der Apfel eines der am häufigsten in Mythen, Märchen und Legenden eingebetteten Lebensmittel: Von der Bibel über die Werke Homers bis zu den Märchen der Brüder Grimm spielt der Apfel immer wieder eine zentrale Rolle.Auch historisch ist er von Belang: Vor 700 Jahren trug er mit Wilhelm Tell zur Gründung der Schweiz bei, und schließlich fiel er Sir Isaac Newton auf den Kopf, womit dieser die Schwerkraft beweisen konnte.

programme.title: Jung und Schausteller
programme.desc: Immer auf Achse, immer im Einsatz: Junge Schausteller und Kirmesfans träumen vom Leben unterwegs. Doch wie attraktiv ist der Jahrmarkt zwischen Freiheit, Familientradition und Existenzsorgen?

programme.title: Servicezeit

programme.title: Da will ich hin!
programme.desc: Die Hafenstadt Rijeka, die drittgrößte Stadt Kroatiens, liegt an der nördlichen Adria und gilt als Tor zu den Inseln in der Kvarner Bucht. 2020 war sie Kulturhauptstadt Europas.

programme.title: Grünes Wunder Costa Rica
programme.desc: Lange Traumstrände, üppiger Dschungel, faszinierende Vulkane und heiße Quellen - dazu eine artenreiche Fauna und Flora: Costa Rica ist in vielerlei Hinsicht etwas ganz Besonderes.

programme.title: Sara Nuru – Abenteuer Mexiko
programme.desc: Mexiko ist ein Land mit einer beeindruckenden Vielfalt an Kultur, Geschichte, mit abwechslungsreicher Küche, prächtiger Architektur und natürlich Traumstränden.

programme.title: Sara Nuru – Abenteuer Mexiko
programme.desc: In dieser Folge taucht Sara Nuru in Mexiko in einen ebenso verschlossenen wie geheimnisvollen Kosmos ein, in die Welt des Lucha Libre, der mexikanischen Variante des Wrestlings.

programme.title: Unter Raubkatzen und Ameisenbären - Mit Lydia Möcklinghoff in Brasiliens Tierwelt
programme.desc: Mitten im Pantanal, dem größten Feuchtgebiet der Erde, ist die Verhaltensbiologin Lydia Möcklinghoff den Geheimnissen der Großen Ameisenbären auf der Spur. Die Dynamik von Hochwasser und Trockenzeit lässt ein einzigartiges Mosaik aus Flüssen, Seen, Sümpfen, Galeriewäldern und Pampa entstehen. Weit ab von großen Städten liegen vereinzelt Farmen in der Wildnis wie die Fazenda Barranco Alto. Hier forscht Lydia Möcklinghoff.Mit dem Pferd oder Kanu kommt sie auch an schwer erreichbare Orte, um Kamerafallen aufzustellen. Auf ihrem Weg begegnen ihr Riesenotter, Jaguare, Pumas, Hyazintharas und natürlich Große Ameisenbären. Einige von ihnen kennt sie schon seit Jahren. Sie sind für sie wie alte Bekannte.Gerade im Pantanal kann man den großen Erfolg von Artenschutzprojekten tagtäglich erleben. Viele Säugetiere und exotische Vögel waren im vergangenen Jahrhundert nahezu ausgerottet. Doch nur was man kennt, kann man schützen. Deshalb sind Lydia und viele andere Biologen weiterhin im Pantanal unterwegs, um den Arten des südamerikanischen Kontinents eine sichere Zukunft zu bieten.

programme.title: Hüter der Erde
programme.desc: Hoch hinaus geht es auf der Reise nach Tolconi in Peru. Dort lernt das Kamerateam Atok kennen, der leichten Fußes seine Alpaka-Herde die Berge hinuntertreibt. Es ist eine raue Gegend.

programme.title: Hüter der Erde
programme.desc: Knut Kucznik ist einer der letzten deutschen Wanderhirten der Mark Brandenburg. Knut lebt in Altlandsberg, eine knappe Autostunde östlich von Berlin.

programme.title: Hüter der Erde
programme.desc: Anfang Juni treiben die kirgisischen Hirten ihre Herden hoch in die Berge des westlichen Himmelsgebirges Tian Shan, auf die weiten Sommerweiden in fast 2500 Metern Höhe.

programme.title: Hüter der Erde
programme.desc: Mit ihren roten Turbanen und ihrer stolzen Haltung gleichen die Raika-Hirten im Nordwesten von Rajasthan Figuren aus Tausendundeiner Nacht.

programme.title: Hüter der Erde
programme.desc: Am Horn von Afrika, im Nordosten Ugandas, hütet der Hirte Modo Engoria seine Rinder. Er gehört zum Hirtenvolk der Karamojong.

programme.desc: Drei Mitarbeiter des Regenbogenvereins, der sich um Menschen mit Behinderung kümmert, werden kurz nacheinander ermordet. Kommissarin Ann Kathrin Klaasen und ihr Team stossen bei ihren Ermittlungen auf Erstaunliches. Erster Ostfrieslandkrimi nach den Romanen von Klaus-Peter Wolf mit Christiane Paul.
Weit weg von ihrer Heimat beginnen Espérance, Minh und Aswin eine Pflegeausbildung in Deutschland. Der schwierige Start in einem fremden Land ist für alle eine große Herausforderung.

programme.title: Landfrauenküche
programme.desc: Martina ist Sennerin auf einer Alm im Mangfallgebirge. Zusammen mit ihrem Partner Andi kümmert sie sich um 140 Rinder, 30 Ziegen, zwei Ponys und eine Schar Hühner. Martina stammt aus einem kleinen Milchviehbetrieb im oberbayerischen Chiemgau. Gelernt hat sie Krankenschwester. Als sie zum ersten Mal auf die Alm zog, wusste sie nicht, wie sehr diese Entscheidung ihr Leben auf den Kopf stellen würde. Denn die Alm ist für Martina weit mehr als ein Beruf.

programme.title: Im Flug über
programme.desc: Vom Indischen Ozean bis in die über 3000 Meter hohen Drakensberge bietet Südafrika vielfältige Landschaften, weite Strände und moderne Millionenstädte mit einer bewegten Geschichte.

programme.title: Serengeti - Wilde Geschichten aus der Savanne
programme.desc: Die sechsteilige Reihe Serengeti eröffnet ungewöhnliche Einblicke in den Überlebenskampf bekannter und unbekannter Raubtiere in einem der letzten legendären Naturreservate der Erde.

programme.title: Serengeti - Wilde Geschichten aus der Savanne
programme.desc: Die Savanne steht in Flammen, und ihre Bewohner kämpfen ums Überleben. Nach dem Feuer müssen alle Tierfamilien Wege finden, um in der verkohlten Landschaft Wasser und Nahrung aufzuspüren.

programme.title: Serengeti - Wilde Geschichten aus der Savanne
programme.desc: Das Land erholt sich nach dem Feuer und der Fluss führt reichlich Wasser. Während die Löwenjungen schutzlos den Gefahren der Savanne ausgesetzt sind, muss das Nilpferdbaby im Fluss überleben lernen.

programme.title: Serengeti - Wilde Geschichten aus der Savanne
programme.desc: Den Kampf um einen Inselberg entscheiden Löwen für sich. Die Paviantruppe muss das Feld räumen. Auch Flussbewohner stellen sich großen Herausforderungen, wenn es um ihren Nachwuchs geht.

programme.title: Serengeti - Wilde Geschichten aus der Savanne
programme.desc: Trockenzeit in der Savanne. Die Tiere kämpfen um begrenzte Wasser- und Futterressourcen. An wenigen verbliebenen Tümpeln kommt es zu heftigen Auseinandersetzungen und großem Chaos.

programme.title: Serengeti - Wilde Geschichten aus der Savanne
programme.desc: In der ausgetrockneten Savanne kämpfen Tiere um Wasser und Nahrung. Flusspferde stecken im Schlammloch fest, Elefanten ziehen weiter. Doch mit dem ersten Regen erwacht die Natur zu neuem Leben.

programme.title: Damen
programme.desc: Maya, Mitte 30, lebt in einer Münchner Wohngemeinschaft mit der temperamentvollen Sema, Optikerin und zugleich Influencerin, und versucht, möglichst unbeschwert in der Gegenwart zu leben. Doch das Messie-Problem ihrer Mutter, bei dem ihr Vater leider auch keine Hilfe ist, holt sie ein. Ihre Balance zwischen den Jobs als mobile Nagelpflegerin und freie Maskenbildnerin am Theater gerät zunehmend ins Wanken - und dann verliebt sie sich auch noch in den Paradiesvogel des Stückes, verkörpert von dem charmanten, aber etwas flatterhaften Tänzer Philip. Zum Glück wird Maya von einer Gruppe kluger, humorvoller Damen verschiedenster Herkunft umgeben, die ihr mit perfekten Fingernägeln, Witz und Lebensweisheiten zur Seite stehen. Denn nur wer auch mal zurückblickt, findet den Rückenwind zum Abheben. So verschmelzen überraschend und wundersam die Geschichten afroamerikanischer GIs, vietnamesischer Boatpeople sowie türkischer und angolanischer Einwanderer im Hier und Heute und mit Mayas Leben in München.

programme.title: Sturm kommt auf
programme.desc: Die beklemmende Darstellung des aufkommenden Faschismus in der Provinz anhand der bewegten, gleichsam berührenden Geschichte des Schusters JuliusKraus.

programme.title: Sturm kommt auf
programme.desc: Zehn Jahre sind vergangen. Die Hakenkreuzler, wie die Hitler-Anhänger genannt werden, treten jetzt überall militärisch auf. Einige im Dorf gehören jetzt zu den Nazis.

programme.title: Rec.
programme.desc: Julia lebt mit unheilbarem, metastasiertem Brustkrebs. Trotz der drastisch verkürzten Lebenserwartung gelingt es der 30-Jährigen immer wieder, sich dem Leben zuzuwenden.
