programme.desc: Jonah elsker dyr mere end noget andet, og sammen med sin far rejser han ud og finder de sejeste - og mest skræmmende - dyr. Norsk dokumentarserie.

programme.title: Hvem lagde lorten?
programme.desc: Fuglen.

programme.title: Motor Mille og Børnebanden
programme.desc: Den Sure Mand i det store hus har taget målene fra fodboldbanen, og han laver dem om til havemøbler. Motor Mille og Børnebanden lægger en snedig og vild plan for at få fodboldmålene tilbage.

programme.title: Skæg med bogstaver
programme.desc: I dag besøger Hr. Skæg den fine restaurant Ø, hvor han lærer at lave en spændende ret. Han skal også have fat i en økse i gaveboden hos søde Persille, som bliver drillet af en fræk bogstav-stjælende mus. Hr. Skæg kan også både en dans og en sang med Ø.

programme.title: Byttebiksen
programme.desc: Rosa har sådan en fin knold i håret, synes Lotte. Så sådan én vil Lotte også gerne have. Desværre har Lotte ikke så langt hår. Til gengæld er hun opfindsom. Magnus er en dreng, der rigtig godt kan lide at slappe af. Det giver Rosa en idé. Hun får også en god idé, da hun er med ude i Valdemars træhule. Hjemme i Byttebiksen lærer Sara Lotte alt muligt om Justin Bieber.

programme.title: Mission Valhalla
programme.desc: Frejas Falkeham er forsvundet! Den magiske fjerham, der kan forvandle dig til og gøre dig i stand til at flyve som en falk. Det er ikke så godt, hvis den er faldet i de forkerte hænder. Tænk hvis en af de onde jætter brugte den til at snige sig in i Valhalla? Tordenguden Thor drager, sammen med den modige, jordiske helt Christian ud for at skaffe falkehammen tilbage. For Valhalla!

programme.title: Zig og Sharko
programme.desc: En klassisk slapstick-animationsserie uden ord i bedste 'Hjulben og Ulven'-stil. Den evigt sultne hyæne Zig finder på mere og mere sindrige planer for at fange og spise den søde havfrue Marina, men heldigvis er havfruens bedste ven, en haj ved navn Sharko, god til at afværge hyænens planer. Og det er lige opfindsomt, voldeligt og super sjovt hver gang!

programme.title: Mini-Agenterne
programme.desc: Krimstads børnehave har fået stjålet ALLE sine legesager, og børnene kan ikke komme tilbage, før mysteriet er blevet løst. Nu er det vigtigt for Mini-Agenterne at arbejde hurtigt for at finde ud af, hvem den skyldige er.

programme.title: Sprinter Galore
programme.desc: Sprinter lander sit rumskib for at hjælpe to piger, der er oppe mod to seje drenge i et sæbekasseløb. Men er pigerne ikke lige så seje, når det kommer til stykket? Og har de overhovedet brug for hjælp?

programme.title: Sprinter Galore
programme.desc: Sprinter lander igen for lige at hjælpe til, og her møder han Ditte, der ikke må malke en Ko for sin far, fordi hun er for lille. Men er hun nu også det?

programme.title: Karlas Fantalastiske Klasse
programme.desc: Den sprudlende og energifulde kylling Karla på 8 år elsker skolen og sine venner - hun brænder for at gøre alle glade, men ender alligevel nogle gange med at skuffe en ven. Karlas Fantalastiske Klasse er danske tegnefilm, som handler om at være barn og alle de følelser det indebærer.

programme.title: F for Får
programme.desc: Det velansete animationsselskab Aardman (Wallace And Gromit, Chicken Run) står bag denne leranimerede serie om det opfindsomme får Shaun. Han bor på en gård med sin brogede flok, hvor de finder på en masse narrestreger, men også må arbejde hårdt for at holde skjult overfor bonden, hvor kvikke de i virkeligheden er.

programme.title: Jade Armor
programme.desc: Lan Jun og Theo kæler for en killing og bytter kroppe! Lan Jun får brug for kattens Stump, men katten er meget svær at fange. I Lans Juns krop kan Theo ikke modstå at blive til Jade. Hjælper han, eller gør han bare tingene værre?

programme.title: Tintin
programme.desc: En meteor falder ned i ishavet, og Tintin tage af sted sammen med en ekspedition af videnskabsmænd. Men nogen prøver at forhindre dem i at nå frem. Hvorfor mon!

programme.title: Æblerup
programme.desc: Trafalgar og Pulver holder den bedste nytårsaften sammen med sjove Onkel Knud. Dagen efter keder de sig og ærgrer sig over, at der er et helt år, før det bliver nytårsaften igen. Så får Onkel Knud en god idé - de kan jo bare fejre nydags-dag!

programme.title: Æblerup
programme.desc: En popstjerne er blevet set i Æblerup. Alle vil have hendes autograf. Undtagen Trafalgar og Pulver, som vil have autografer fra totalt ukendte mennesker. Men det er meget svært at finde et totalt ukendt menneske.

programme.title: Dragerytterne
programme.desc: Førhen var vikinger og drager dødsfjender, men det ændrede sig, da den unge viking Hikke mødte dragen Tandløs. De to venner kommer dog på noget af en opgave, da Bersærkø får sit helt eget Dragetræningsakademi - for det fører til masser af spændende eventyr. Men det er ikke alle, der går ind for, at drager og mennesker lever side om side i fred og harmoni.

programme.title: Mesterlige monsterbørn
programme.desc: Arthur tager børnene med til sin yndlings isbutik for at smage verdens bedste is - men man skal følge en særlig regel, ellers bryder helvede løs.

programme.title: De 3 musketerer
programme.desc: En for alle, og alle for en! De tre musketerer og D'Artagnan er klar til at beskytte hele kongeriget mod skumle skurke i denne animerede nyfortolkning af Dumas' klassiske fortælling.

programme.title: Peter Pedal
programme.desc: Sæbekassebilen + BogabenDer sker altid noget, hvis man er lidt fræk... og det er den nysgerrige abe Peter Pedal. Bygget over Margret og H. A. Reys klassiske børnebøger.

programme.title: Gurli Gris
programme.desc: Gurli er en elskelig, fræk lille gris, som bor sammen med sin lillebror Gustav, mor Gris og far Gris. Gurli elsker at lege, at klæde sig ud, at besøge spændende steder og at få nye venner, men hendes absolutte yndlingsbeskæftigelse er at hoppe rundt i mudder!

programme.desc: Gurli er en elskelig, fræk lille gris, som bor sammen med sin lillebror Gustav, mor Gris og far Gris. Gurli elsker at lege, at klæde sig ud, at besøge spændende steder og at få nye venner, men hendes absolutte yndlingsbeskæftigelse er at hoppe rundt i mudder!

programme.desc: Franske tegnefilm om den lille kanin Simon, der prøver kræfter med alt det, hverdagen byder på. Han møder verden med åbenhed, men også med sund skepsis og spirende selvstændighed. Bygget over en populær billedbogsserie af Stephanie Blake.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon har altid drømt om at kunne alt det, de store superhelte kan - nu har han chancen i helt nye episoder, hvor Simon ikke bare er kanin - men Superkanin! Fransk tegnefilmserie.

programme.desc: Klar til eventyr - med sømmet i bund! Batman, Robin og Batgirls køretøjer bliver levende, og Gotham City får et helt nyt hold af helte, der kæmper for retfærdighed og fanger forbrydere. Amerikansk animeret superhelteserie med figurer fra DCs univers.

programme.desc: Dracula har bygget et hotel i Transylvania langt væk fra mennesker, hvor han kan opdrage sin datter Mavis i trygge omgivelser. Her inviterer han nogle af verdens mest berømte monstre på besøg.

programme.title: Pokémon - Sol og måne
programme.desc: Nye udfordringer for Ash og hans søgen efter at blive Pokémon-mester! Ash og Pikachu udforsker den solrige Alola region, hvor de opdager spændende nye Pokemon og mennesker. Men fjenderne fra Team Rocket har også taget turen til Alola, så der bliver kamp til stregen!Japansk tegnefilmserie med dansk tale.

programme.title: Paw Patrol
programme.desc: Da en ål ved et uheld sluger et stykke af meteoren og bliver kæmpestor, er det op til Mighty Pups at redde Adventure Bay. / Efter Pusser beslutter sig for at beslaglægge prinsessens kongelige karet, sender sørøveren Sid Arrby ud for at stjæle den.

programme.desc: En serie om store og betydningsfulde mennesker - dengang de var børn. De har leget, grinet, drillet, fjollet - og de har også været uheldige, bange eller kede af det, for vejen gennem livet er sjældent lige uden bump og omveje.

programme.title: Vilde vidunderlige dyr
programme.desc: En han-edderkop leder efter en hun-edderkop, som han kan parre sig med. Men en hun-edderkop kan godt finde på at spise en han-edderkop. Så han-edderkoppen må tage en gave med til hende, for ikke blive spist. Hvad tror du han giver hun-edderkoppen i gave?

programme.title: Vilde vidunderlige dyr
programme.desc: Et træ er blevet fældet. Det er et dyr, som har gjort det. Hvis vi kigger nærmere på træet, finder vi noget, som måske kan lede os nærmere en opklaring af mysteriet. Der er nemlig bidemærker i træet. Hvilket dyr tror du mon, der kan fælde træer med tænderne?

programme.desc: Messi tager med sin ven Hannah til cirkustræning. Messi er klar til at vise alle sine talenter som cirkusartist. Men kan han vente på, at det bliver hans tur til at springe igennem ringen? Og kan han finde ud af at jonglere med andet end fodbolde?

Onkel Reje har desuden fundet en metode, hvor han med Brilles hjælp kan løfte sløret for, hvad meningen med livet er. I Didrik og Skidriks racerbane indgår en skraldespand i Skidriks plan for at skaffe Jytte af vejen.

programme.desc: Hvad skal Dylan være i dag? Pizzabud, læge eller frisør? - Dylan prøver det hele, og du lan lege med! Den stribede hund elsker at lege, og hver gang leger han, at han er noget nyt. Tegnefilmserie bygget over bøgerne af Guy Parker-Rees.

programme.title: Oda Omvendt

programme.desc: Mageløse Mille er 8 år og vild med at opfinde ting og løse problemer - og med hjælp fra sine venner og sin fantasi klarer hun næsten alt på sin helt egen, kreative måde. Canadisk animationsserien bygget over en børnebogsserie af Ashley Spires.

programme.desc: Hvad ville du sige til at bo på en gård, hvor alle dyrene er dinosaurer? Besøg familien Cassidys ranch, hvor hver dag byder på nye eventyr, spænding og godt kammeratskab mellem Cassidy-børnene og deres dino'er. Canadisk animationsserie.

Robo elmegy Laurához, de a kislány nagyon fél tőle és leesik a lépcsőről.

programme.title: Through The Looking Glass
programme.desc: Moya tries to starburst to prove herself but it goes wrong when she gets split into several dimensions.

programme.title: A Bug's Life
programme.desc: A peacekeeper ship approaches Moya, so Crichton and Aeryn pose as peacekeeper officers on a secret mission.

programme.title: Nerve
programme.desc: Aeryn has been critically wounded. She needs some tissue samples to heal. The only source is the Secret base.

programme.title: The Hidden Memory
programme.desc: Scorpius attempts to extract the wormhole technology from Crichton's mind. Aeryn mounts a rescue operation.

programme.title: Bone To Be Wild
programme.desc: The crew find a planetoid that's a paradise occupied by a scientist and a girl. But one is a killer.

programme.title: Family Ties
programme.desc: Moya's crew say their final goodbyes and share a last feast together, before trying to save Moya and her baby.

programme.title: Mind The Baby
programme.desc: Crichton, Aeryn and D'argo are stranded in an asteroid field while Scorpius searches for them.

programme.title: Vitas Mortis
programme.desc: D'Argo does a sacred ritual to help an old Luxan survive. He draws energy from Moya making her age rapidly.

programme.title: Taking The Stone
programme.desc: Chiana leaves Moya and goes to 'grave planet' populated by thrill seekers who play life threatening games.

programme.title: Crackers Don't Matter
programme.desc: A visitor comes on Moya with a device that could cloak Moya and everyone starts acting paranoid.

programme.title: The Way We Weren't
programme.desc: Chiana finds a recording with Moya's prior Pilot. Pilot orders Aeryn to leave after realizing she was there.

programme.title: Picture If You Will
programme.desc: Chiana buys a picture which is more than it seems. The picture shows Chiana what will happen to her.

programme.title: Home On The Remains
programme.desc: The crew needs food. Zhaan needs to eat meat and starts spewing spores. Only Aeryn can tolerate the spores.

programme.title: Dream A Little Dream
programme.desc: After the Gammak base is destroyed, Zhaan is on trial for murder. Chiana and Rygel act as her defense lawyers.

programme.title: Out Of Their Minds
programme.desc: An alien ship fires a weapon at Moya. The blast causes everyone's consciousness to jump into another body.

programme.title: My Three Crichtons
programme.desc: Crichton is cloned into a version who is a de-evolved 'cave man' and another who has increased mental ability.

programme.title: Look At The Princess, Part 1: A Kiss Is But A Kiss
programme.desc: Princess Katralla, cannot ascend unless she finds a mate genetically compatible to her poisoned DNA.

programme.title: Look At The Princess, Part 2: I Do, I Think
programme.desc: The Queen offers Crichton a choice; marry her daughter or she'll turn him over to Scorpius.

programme.title: Look At The Princess, Part 3: The Maltese Crichton
programme.desc: Crichton faces 80 years as a statue. The Scarran Cargn decapitates the statue and drops the head into acid.

programme.title: Beware Of Dog
programme.desc: The crew bring aboard an alien tracker to remove some creatures that came aboard hidden in some cargo.

programme.title: Won't Get Fooled Again
programme.desc: Crichton returns to Earth. Or has he always been on Earth? Is this some trick, if so who is behind it and why.

programme.title: The Locket
programme.desc: A time distortion traps Aeryn and John to live out the rest of their lives. On Moya it's only a few hours.

programme.title: The Ugly Truth
programme.desc: Crais and Talyn return. The crew are put on trial for an attack that Talyn made on an alien ship.

programme.title: A Clockwork Nebari
programme.desc: A Nebari group come aboard Moya and attempt to mind cleanse everyone using a drug.

programme.title: Liars, Guns And Money: Part 1, A Not So Simple Plan
programme.desc: Stark helps the crew with a plan to steal money from a depository to free D'Argo's son, Jothee, from slavery.

programme.title: Liars, Guns And Money: Part 2, With Friends Like These
programme.desc: With the loot from the Depository heist at hand, D'Argo waits to make contact with the Slave Traders.

programme.title: Liars, Guns And Money, Part 3: Plan B
programme.desc: The crew breaks into the depository to free Crichton with the help of Talyn's unexpected arrival.

programme.title: Die Me, Dichotomy
programme.desc: The crew meets with a famous surgeon whom they hope can heal Moya's burns and remove Crichton's neural chip.

programme.title: Season Of Death
programme.desc: D'Argo and Stark try to heal John, while Scorpius tries to avoid discovery. Zhaan makes a personal sacrifice.

programme.title: Suns And Lovers
programme.desc: Moya docks at a commerce station. Disaster strikes when the station is hit by a storm.

programme.title: Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 1: Could'a, Would'a, Should'a
programme.desc: Moya approaches a wormhole, gets pulled in and fused to another ship.

programme.title: Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 2: Wait For The Wheel
programme.desc: The crew escapes the other ship and wormhole. Things are complicated when their new 'friends' sabotage Moya.

programme.title: Different Destinations
programme.desc: Stark accidentally sends himself, Crichton, Aeryn. D'Argo and Jool back in time where they alter the timeline.

programme.title: Eat Me
programme.desc: Crichton lands his transport pod on a dying leviathan full of cannibals and a scientist who can create clones.

programme.title: Thanks For Sharing
programme.desc: Moya rendezvous with Talyn who is seriously hurt. D'Argo and Rygel try to find Clorium, a drug to help Talyn.

programme.title: Green Eyed Monster
programme.desc: Talyn is swallowed by a boodong, leaving Stark and Rygel stranded in a transport pod.

programme.title: Losing Time
programme.desc: Moya's crew starts blacking out and missing portions of time. Pilot becomes inhabited by another entity.

programme.title: Relativity
programme.desc: Talyn lands on a planet covered with healing plants. Crichton, Aeryn and Crais leave the ship to find Xhalax.

programme.title: Incubator
programme.desc: Scorpius puts the neural chip into his own brain in an attempt to retrieve vital wormhole equations from Crichton.

programme.title: Meltdown
programme.desc: Talyn wants to fly into a sun. While near it Stark is contacted by an alien woman being held against her will.

programme.title: Scratch N Sniff
programme.desc: Pilot forces Crichton, D'Argo, Jool and Chiana to take a holiday as he is fed up with their bickering.

programme.title: Infinite Possibilities, Part 1: Daedalus Demands
programme.desc: Crichton must seek out an old friend who has gained too much knowledge about wormholes.

programme.title: Infinite Possibilities, Part 2: Icarus Abides
programme.desc: Jack unlocks Crichton's wormhole knowledge so they can build a device to destroy the Scarran dreadnought.

programme.title: Revenging Angel
programme.desc: D'Argo injures Crichton, as Crichton lies in a coma/near death, he escapes into a highly animated world.

programme.title: The Choice
programme.desc: Aeryn leaves to grieve on a planet. She spots someone who might be her father but not all reunions are happy.

programme.title: Fractures
programme.desc: Escaped prisoners come aboard Moya followed shortly by Aeryn, Crais and Rygel who have returned from Talyn.

programme.title: I - Yensch, You - Yensch
programme.desc: D'Argo and Rygel meet Braca and Scorpius in a cafe to conduct negotiations when it is unexpectedly attacked.

programme.title: Into The Lion's Den, Part 1: Lambs To The Slaughter
programme.desc: The crew must stop Scorpius's research. They must board the command carrier and destroy it from within.

programme.title: Into The Lion's Den, Part 2: Wolf In Sheep's Clothing
programme.desc: Crais gets Talyn to starburst inside the command carrier, causing it to collapse in on itself.

programme.title: Dog With Two Bones
programme.desc: Moya takes Talyn's remains to the sacred burial ground. D'Argo destroys a Leviathan that attacks other ships.

programme.title: Crichton Kicks
programme.desc: Crichton, now aboard a dying leviathan, encounters an alien named Sikozu who aids him in stopping the Grudeks.

programme.title: What Was Lost, Part 1: Sacrifice
programme.desc: Everyone but Aeryn meets on Arnesk, where Jool has discovered the remains of an ancient civilization.

programme.title: What Was Lost, Part 2: Resurrection
programme.desc: The crew discovers Scorpius has fallen in the Peacekeeper ranks. They must stop the magnetic storm on Arnesk.

programme.title: Lava's A Many Splendored Thing
programme.desc: The crew is enroute to meet with Moya. They eat Noranti's concoction and raiders entomb Rygel in amber.

programme.title: Promises
programme.desc: Everyone reunites on Moya. Aeryn returns with Scorpius, who claims he saved the former Peacekeeper's life.

programme.title: Natural Election
programme.desc: Crichton correctly predicts a wormhole's appearance near Moya, but simultaneously a giant space plant captures the Leviathan.

programme.title: John Quixote
programme.desc: Crichton and Chiana get stuck in a video game where they encounter strange/twisted versions of their friends.

programme.title: I Shrink Therefore I Am
programme.desc: When Moya is raided by Peacekeeper bounty hunters, everyone is captured except for Crichton and Noranti.

programme.title: A Prefect Murder
programme.desc: While Moya's crew are resupplying on a xenophobic planet, Aeryn kills the next prefect.

programme.title: Coup By Clam
programme.desc: The crew consume food, sharing amongst themselves. But if not ingested by the same person, it becomes deadly.

programme.title: Unrealized Reality
programme.desc: Crichton falls into a wormhole and meets a strange man who shows Crichton the consequences of wormhole travel.

programme.title: Kansas
programme.desc: Crichton accidentally alters the past, causing his dad to fly on the doomed shuttle 'Challenger'.

programme.title: Terra Firma
programme.desc: Crichton has arrived home. Although the crew relaxes, Crichton can't seem to adjust to life on Earth.

programme.title: Twice Shy
programme.desc: Moya takes on a new passenger, but she is an alien in disguise, intent on harvesting the crew's neural energy.

programme.title: Mental As Anything
programme.desc: The crew's males undergo training. Crichton learns how to resist Scarran probes, D'Argo learns self control.

programme.title: Bringing Home The Beacon
programme.desc: The women of Moya travel to a dead Leviathan to buy a sensor beacon that will allow Moya to camouflage.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: Glory 09: New York was a kickboxing event held on June 22, 2013 at the Hammerstein Ballroom in New York City, New York. This event featured a Glory 95kg Slam Tournament.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 11 Superfight Series: on October 12, 2013 at the Sears Centre at Hoffman Estates, Illinois. The highlight of the event featured a Glory Heavyweight World Championship Tournament. Two tournament matches were held, with a third match as reserve. The winners of the two semi-final bouts, proceeded to the finals for the championship main-event. The event also featured other non-tournament bouts.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY heads to Chicago and brings a heavyweigth tournament showcasing the best in the heavyweight division.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 12 Superfight Series. On November 23, 2013 at The Theater at Madison Square Garden at New York City, New York. The highlight of the event featured a Glory Lightweight World Championship Tournament. Two tournament matches were held, with a third match as reserve. programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 16 slams into Denver with the Welterweight World Title fight, the Heavyweight Contender Tournament, and the debut of USA Martial Arts sensation Pat Barry. Belgian striker Marc de Bonte will battle Armenia's technical machine Karapet Karapetyan for the vacant GLORY Welterweight World Title, guaranteeing a fast, explosive war. At the heaviest end of the GLORY ranks, the big-boys are set to battle it out for a higher ranked spot in the Heavyweight division, and a chance to fight for the Title later within the year. The lineup pits Errol The Bonecrusher Zimmerman versus Bangin Ben Edwards in a semi-final, and Sergei The Paratrooper Kharitonov vs. Anderson Braddock Silva in another semi-final. The tournament winner will have to win two fights in one night to claim the prize, and the right to fight for a bigger prize later in the year. Also at Heavyweight, in a tournament reserve match, MMA veteran Pat HD Barry returns to his original love of kickboxing, facing another GLORY debutant in the shape of Zack The Black Warrior Mwekassa.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: On the preliminary card, a 4-Man Featherweight Contender Tournament and other one-off bouts were featured.Mirko Cro Cop was first scheduled to face Pat Barry, and later Sergei Kharitonov on this card. However, on May 21, it was announced that Kharitonov had to withdraw from the fight due to injury. He was replaced by Jarrell Miller.Miguel Torres was scheduled to make his GLORY debut as a participant of the Featherweight tournament. However, on May 28, it was revealed he pulled out of the tournament for undisclosed reasons. He was replaced by Marcus Vinicius.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Host Joanna Chery elevates four Greek dishes using wine and spirits in this episode of One World Kitchen. First up, brown rice Stuffed Mussels infused with Greek dry white wine, tangy lemon juice, and fragrant spices - perfect for a sunny day by the sea. When evening rolls around, Joanna insists that red wine is a must! She makes a Sausage and Pepper Stew packed with golden-brown sausages and colourful bell peppers simmered in yummy tomatoes and a healthy dose of red wine. Then, she pulls out some brandy for a tender and delicious Beef Orzo Casserole. Finally, Joanna uses a traditional licorice-flavoured spirit called ouzo to bake a mouth-watering batch of Drunk Cookies.

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Cheese - a staple in traditional Greek cuisine! Talented home cook Joanna Chery fries up two delicious ap- petizers called Saganaki, both featuring two different types of cheese. First, she fries up kefaltyri, a hard, salty cheese in a dramatic burning flame of ouzo (licorice-flavoured alcohol) - Opa! Then, Joanna shows us a popular Fried Shrimp and Cheese appetizer using tasty feta and tender shrimp. Pair both dishes with a Greek rustic bread and you've nailed it! Next up, Joanna prepares a Greek classic - Spanakopita. This mouth-watering dish is made up of creamy ricotta, crispy phyllo pastry, fresh spinach, and a hint of dill (yum!). Moving on, Joanna showcases her all-time favourite Greek meal - Pastisio. For dessert, cheesy sweet tarts called Melitinia Cookies. Commonly served at parties, these ooey-gooey mascarpone-filled creations are to die for!

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Home cook Joanna Chery prepares a series of traditional Greek dishes including Stuffed Vine Leaves - a classic dish made of lemon-doused grape leaves and stuffed with fluffy rice, fragrant herbs, and juicy beef. Then, she prepares a healthy and hearty dish called Giant Baked Beans. Typically used as a side, it pairs well with Jo- anna's next dish - succulent roast lamb and lemony potatoes. Finally, Joanna makes a Greek specialty - Fried Dough Ribbons. Satisfy your sweet tooth with these fried, coiled dough ribbons drizzled with sweet honey and sprinkled with sugar. Simple, fun, and evERS-popular in Greek cuisine, this dish is great for sharing amongst family and friends.

programme.title: LIVEFEED
programme.desc: Nestled in the heart of Oxbury, Ontario, the Giant Pig Smokehouse opened in 2019, bringing Southern barbecue to life. The journey began in 2018 on Melissa's 30th birthday during a trip to Mexico when her brother proposed the idea of opening a restaurant. Embracing their love for smoked foods and recognizing the local events like Vankleek Hill Fair and Rib Fests, they decided to share their culinary passion beyond their home. The Giant Pig Smokehouse offers a variety of Southern barbecue dishes, with pulled pork poutine and brisket poutine being top sellers. Their pulled pork is described as sweet, saucy, and flavorful, often served in sandwiches or on poutines. The authenticity of their poutin gravy, made with meat drippings, is a highlight for many patrons. Customers praise the establishment for its delicious food and the welcoming atmosphere. Bianca from Gatineau, who tried the brisket poutine, found it amazing and fulfilling. McKenna and Matt from Alberta and Stoweville, Ontario, also shared their positive experiences, highlighting the quality of the barbecue and the friendly service. The owners emphasize the importance of patience in barbecue, advocating for slow cooking and marination to achieve the best flavors. They share their journey from backyard barbecues to a full-fledged restaurant, driven by their love for barbecue and the joy of sharing their creations with others. Working with family has its challenges and rewards. While the bond and trust are invaluable, there are moments of bickering that can be mistaken for conflict by customers. Despite these moments, the family's dedication to their craft and to each other shines through. The Giant Pig Smokehouse is not just a restaurant; it's a family business where love and dedication are infused into every dish. The secret to their success lies in the love and flavor they put into their food, ensuring every meal is as cherished as if it were served to their own family.

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Host Joanna Chery elevates four Greek dishes using wine and spirits in this episode of One World Kitchen. First up, brown rice Stuffed Mussels infused with Greek dry white wine, tangy lemon juice, and fragrant spices - perfect for a sunny day by the sea. When evening rolls around, Joanna insists that red wine is a must! She makes a Sausage and Pepper Stew packed with golden-brown sausages and colourful bell peppers simmered in yummy tomatoes and a healthy dose of red wine. Then, she pulls out some brandy for a tender and delicious Beef Orzo Casserole. Finally, Joanna uses a traditional licorice-flavoured spirit called ouzo to bake a mouth-watering batch of Drunk Cookies.

programme.desc: Desiree Nielsen shows how salads can be a tasty main AND served warm with a grilled romaine salad.

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Cheese - a staple in traditional Greek cuisine! Talented home cook Joanna Chery fries up two delicious ap- petizers called Saganaki, both featuring two different types of cheese. First, she fries up kefaltyri, a hard, salty cheese in a dramatic burning flame of ouzo (licorice-flavoured alcohol) - Opa! Then, Joanna shows us a popular Fried Shrimp and Cheese appetizer using tasty feta and tender shrimp. Pair both dishes with a Greek rustic bread and you've nailed it! Next up, Joanna prepares a Greek classic - Spanakopita. This mouth-watering dish is made up of creamy ricotta, crispy phyllo pastry, fresh spinach, and a hint of dill (yum!). Moving on, Joanna showcases her all-time favourite Greek meal - Pastisio. For dessert, cheesy sweet tarts called Melitinia Cookies. Commonly served at parties, these ooey-gooey mascarpone-filled creations are to die for!

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Home cook Joanna Chery prepares a series of traditional Greek dishes including Stuffed Vine Leaves - a classic dish made of lemon-doused grape leaves and stuffed with fluffy rice, fragrant herbs, and juicy beef. Then, she prepares a healthy and hearty dish called Giant Baked Beans. Typically used as a side, it pairs well with Jo- anna's next dish - succulent roast lamb and lemony potatoes. Finally, Joanna makes a Greek specialty - Fried Dough Ribbons. Satisfy your sweet tooth with these fried, coiled dough ribbons drizzled with sweet honey and sprinkled with sugar. Simple, fun, and evERS-popular in Greek cuisine, this dish is great for sharing amongst family and friends.

programme.title: One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: When planning a multi-course dinner for six, we all think 'go with the classics' and so does sassy chef-host Kim Lallouz. For her, however, it's Classics... with a Twist! Use the One big Recipe and cook along as Bread and Butter gets a smoke, honey, herb, and black sea salt makeover. Next, Shrimp Cocktail is reinvented with a horseradish kick in her Apricot Ketchup. Then, it's Potato Pave as a standalone course, garnished with tangy tarragon crÍ¨me fraiche and briny salmon roe. Prime Rib is as classic as it comes, but with a sous-vide twist and truffle-spiked Pea and Lardon salad, plan to drop everything so you can twist along! For a sweet ending, dress up dessert from your favourite bakery with a cool trick for making easy lavender ice cream. Dinner is love, and you will love this dinner!

programme.title: One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: Spring is in the air for this multi-course dinner One Big Recipe with engaging Chef Kimberly Lallouz. First up, it's Scallop Crudo, and it's peachy! Literally! Lamb Shanks braised with olives and sun-dried tomatoes are next, as an appetizer ragout, lovingly stuffed into pillowy, perfect mini-Yorkshire Puddings. Next, verdant spears of asparagus appear, topped with creamy, crunchy, soft-cooked egg Sauce Gribiche. Halibut is the main event, pan-roasted steaks are served over king trumpet Dill Pesto Mushrooms and finished with many melty coins of punchy Pink Peppercorn Compound Butter. The entire dinner is laid out in the signature One Big Recipe format, easy to follow, easy to make and guaranteed to impress!

programme.title: LIVEFEED
programme.desc: Golden Fries, a food truck venture founded by Jesse Teasdale and his wife, has become a popular spot at Bluesfest Ottawa. The truck, which started as a one-woman operation, quickly gained traction and now sees massive crowds, even requiring early gate openings for events like the Foo Fighters' performance. The menu highlights a classic poutine, made with fresh-cut fries, squeaky cheese curds, and rich gravy, as its top-selling item. The video captures various attendees raving about the quality and taste of the food, emphasizing the truck's commitment to using local, high-quality ingredients. Additionally, the video showcases the preparation and dedication that goes into running the truck, from early morning setups to handling large orders for bands and their crews. The narrative underscores the community spirit and the joy of sharing delicious food at live events.

programme.title: Holiday Eatz
programme.desc: Get your 'Gobble Gobble' on with this special episode of Holiday Eatz, featuring fun and charming host Kimberly Lallouz! She starts her terrific Turkey Day menu with a harvest happy Kale Salad heaped with beets, candied pecans, toasted lentils, and goat cheese. Thanksgiving dinner needs Hot Rolls, Chef Lallouz packs hers with cranberries and corn, then serves them as a standalone course with a cheesy, creamy Mushroom Fondue! Next, it's time to talk turkey with a trick that cuts your poultry cooking time in half! Her Spatchcock Turkey is not just faster than old school, it's yummier too, with a garlic-herb marinade and a unique side of mixed beans and rice! Candied sweet potatoes and marshmallows make their perennial appearance here, but Chef Kimberly has a version that will fry... your brain! Check out her Sweet Potato Churros with Marshmallow Creme for a presentation you... do-nut... want to miss!

programme.desc: In preparation for a relaxing holiday with friends and family, FLOUR POWER THANKSGIVING: PIES GALORE invites you into the kitchen to bring a twist to your Thanksgiving classics. Pasta follows, but in keeping with her topsy turvy theme, Korean flavour meets Italian savour in her Kimchi Pappardelle. programme.title: One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: What on earth and/or sea is super fun host Kim Lallouz cooking this week for her One Big Recipe? You guessed it - Surf and Turf! First on the beach are her Singapore-inspired Chili Crab Cakes, redolent with southeast Asian aromatics and spices like lemongrass, ginger, and galangal. 'Turf's up' next with a fresh off-the-hoof Marrow Toast plate decked out with melty marrow, crispy crostini, and garlicky parsley salad. We all deserve a creamy cheesy break (right?), so of course Risotto Carbonara with Crispy Pancetta and Enoki Mushrooms follows. Braised Veal Osso Bucco is the big deal main course, all shored up surfingly with scrumptious Seared Scallops and smoky Grilled Broccoli Rabe!

programme.title: Hunting Hitler
programme.desc: S1 E7 — Friends in High placesBob Baer och Dr John Cencich upptäcker Hitlers potentiella vägar framåt i Argentina där en nära förtrogen till Hitler drev ett mystiskt hotell. Teamet undersöker det numera borttagna hotellet och hittar ögonvittnen som säger att de sett Hitler på platsen.

programme.title: Digging For The Truth
programme.desc: S2 E9 — Stonehenge Secrets RevealedStonehenge är ett av världens mest berömda och mystiska byggnadsverk. Nu utreder värden Josh Bernstein dess ursprung och den förhistoriska värld som omgav det.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: S6 E9 — Aliens And Forbidden IslandsLegender om försvunna, mystiska öar, avancerade civilisationer och Edenlika paradis har berättats av sjömän under hela vår historia. Är det möjligen så att historierna är mer än bara myter påhittade av fantasirika sjöfarare?

programme.title: Brad Meltzer's Lost History
programme.desc: S1 E1 — The Ground Zero FlagDet mest chockerande försvunna föremålet av alla: Den ikoniska Ground Zero-flaggan som hissades av brandmän under 11 september. Några timmar senare försvann det heliga föremålet.

programme.title: The Curse of Oak Island

programme.title: Storage Wars

programme.title: Storage Wars

programme.title: Storage Wars

programme.title: Kod Nas Doma
programme.desc: Nova pjesma Mile Kekina zove se Marko nogomet, ali nema baš mnogo veze ni s Markom ni s nogometom. Ima zato s mobitelima, tajnama koje u njima čuvamo i našom kreativnošću kada nešto želimo sakriti. Što se krije iza neobičnog naslova, ali i što nam još glazbeno sprema, otkrit će nam Mile Kekin!Kako tinejdžeru koji živi uz mobitel, streaming i društvene mreže reći: Slušaj ovo! i pritom mu pustiti Čajkovskog, Ravela ili Chopina? Upravo to pokušava novi glazbeno-scenski projekt HRT-a i Lisinskog. S nama su redatelj Krešimir Dolenčić te braća, glumac Jan Kovačić i skladatelj Vigo Kovačić!Tko će nakon grupe LELEK dobiti priliku predstavljati Hrvatsku na Eurosongu, još ne znamo, ali potraga je službeno počela! Otvoren je natječaj za Doru 2027., a što trebaju znati oni koji već imaju pjesmu, ili je tek trebaju dovršiti, otkrit će nam voditelj projekta Dora Tomislav Štengl!

programme.title: Potjera
programme.desc: U Potjeri četiri natjecatelja odgovaraju na pitanja općeg znanja te istodobno grade taktiku koja će ih dovesti do finalnog kruga. Međutim, na putu im stoji lovac. Taj će ih (ne)uobičajeni protivnik u uzbudljivoj igri znanja i brzine pokušati jednog po jednog izbaciti iz igre i ispratiti ih kući praznih ruku.

programme.title: A Taste of Travel S4 - Ho Chi Minh City

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show S1 - Barcelona And London
programme.desc: If you’re a budding architect or simply an admirer of beautiful buildings this episode takes in some of best in Europe from London and Barcelona.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show S1 - Grand Cayman And Toledo
programme.desc: From the beautiful Hell on earth, a small town in the Grand Cayman islands, to the equally hot planes of Toledo for a safari, Spanish style.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S2 - Coolest Travel Facts and Figures
programme.desc: Get the ultimate tips, facts, and essential figures needed for hiking, snorkeling, and dining on your next perfect trip.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S2 - Adventure in Austria
programme.desc: Scale the Alps, cruise the Blue Danube, explore Vienna, and see how a historic salt castle became a beautiful European city.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S2 - Coolest Motorized Races
programme.desc: Watch intense motorized races through Malaysian rainforests, around the Isle of Man, up Pike’s Peak, and across sunny Australia.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - Costa del Pub
programme.desc: A couple battles delays opening a seafood restaurant in Spain. Londoners chase their BAndB dream in rural France while a Costa del Sol pub gears up for summer crowds.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - Seafood Dream
programme.desc: Will a couple be able to open their seafood restaurant without any further hitches? Engine trouble threatens a French couple’s business and a new Spanish bar tries to lure tourists with live music.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - Charente
programme.desc: The couple swap Chelmsford for Charente, but can they open their self-catering complex before summer starts? A seafood restaurant builds a reputation amid tough competition. Londoners host a traditional tea party at their BAndB.

programme.desc: Gregg heads to the German capital for a 3 day trip. He gets to the heart of Berlin’s food scene and gets involved in the beer culture. Between meals he explores the city’s often turbulent past and indulges his love of the musical Cabaret!

programme.title: Weekend Breaks with Gregg Wallace S1 - Amsterdam
programme.desc: Gregg heads to the Dutch capital for a long weekend where he tries out amazing food and drink, gets involved with fascinating local customs, explores life on the canals and uncovers the historical reasons Amsterdam has such a relaxed attitude.

programme.title: Weekend Breaks with Gregg Wallace S2 - Edinburgh
programme.desc: Gregg Wallace explores Edinburgh over 3 days, diving into its history, tasting local classics, and braving a dip in the Firth of Forth.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S1 - Cottage Getaways

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S1 - Perfect Neighbourhood
programme.desc: Remarrying is hard enough let alone combining two families under one roof. With a total of 4 children between the ages of 7 And 16 Jin’s client is definitely going to need lots of space And land in a safe neighborhood.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S1 - Home Sweet Home
programme.desc: Now that Kristen And Kane have opened an office in Toronto, they will be travelling a lot from Vancouver And want somewhere of their own to stay in.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S2 - Tampa Bay Part 1
programme.desc: Unlock Tampa Bay, the heart of Florida’s Gulf coast.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S2 - Tampa Bay Part 2

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S2 - Exuma
programme.desc: Discover The Exumas! One of the most beautiful places on earth.

programme.title: Travel in Style S2 - ASCOT And DUBAI
programme.desc: We visit one of the newest cities in the world – Dubai. We discover have an absolute gem tucked away near Ascot in the English countryside.

programme.title: Travel in Style S2 - SICILY And LOS ANGELES
programme.desc: The majestic yet somewhat sinister volcano of Mount Etna overlooks the delightful city of Taormina in Sicily. Then its time to jet across the Atlantic and check into Hotel Bel-Air Los Angeles.

programme.title: Travel in Style S2 - ST. PETERSBURG And LONDON
programme.desc: This episode takes our team east to Russia to discover its former capital – the magical city of St Petersburg. Well next off our lucky crew head to England to visit the Dorchester hotel in London.

programme.title: Journeys in India S1 - Gir: The last refuge of the Lion
programme.desc: The desert of Gujarat is hardly the place one expects to encounter a lion, but in the scrub forest of the region Bill does exactly that. Join him as he tracks the lion and many less dangerous creatures from spotted deer to owls and parrots.

programme.title: Journeys in India S1 - Kathmandu and Chitwan National Park
programme.desc: Just north of India is a land steeped in mystery—Nepal. Bill tours the city of Kathmandu, visits the World Heritage temple complexes, and walks along the city streets, where ancient and modern vie for space.

programme.title: Food Unknown S1 - Philippines
programme.desc: The nation of 7,000 islands has no problems with beach, sun, or sea; but they suffer tremendously with cuisine image. Jonathan lands in Manila to discover the top chefs are well aware of the issue and, following their advice, he launches off on an expedition to find part of the solution. Driving from headhunting tribal villages, to step-back-in-time colonial towns, to restaurants in the shadow of the American military behemoth an intriguing story slowly pieces together. In the dense jungle one treasure stays buried while another comes literally out of the woodwork. But danger always lurks.. zombie moray eels, landslide prone passes, and forbidden fields behind the rice paddies.

programme.title: Food Unknown S1 - Finland
programme.desc: Finland is that one Nordic country that is never on the global cuisine radar. However, the reserved Finns have been quietly perfecting their craft of foraging culture and incorporating it into their unique cuisine. Jonathan Legg explores the entire expanse of the country to understand it’s cuisine, and the ethos of the country’s top chefs; from amazing locally sourced cuisine in Helsinki, to an expedition in Lapland to learn about foraging and the Finnish delicacy, reindeer!

programme.title: Foodwise S2 - Xilingol
programme.desc: In Xilin Gol, the local cuisines here are so attractive to the tourists, such as the roasted lamb is a traditional local dish. And the fired stone fried lamb is so hard to find if you are not traveling to Inner Mongolia.Just join in this visual trip!

programme.title: Foodwise S2 - Kunming
programme.desc: Join host Tianran He in Kunming, the capital of Yunnan province in southwest China. Named the Spring City for its perennially good weather, Kunming is one of China's most ethnically diverse cities, something that's reflected in its food.

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali S1 - Chocolate
programme.desc: Indulge in Lauren's exploration of the chocolate world as she uncovers its unique types and characteristics. From savory chocolate salsa to raw vegan cake, her mix of sweet and savory recipes leaves a lasting appreciation for this beloved ingredient.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S1 - CRAYFISH + KINA
programme.desc: SYNOPSIS: In this episode, Piri Weepu heads to Tolaga Bay in search of crayfish and kina with the help of local, Richard Meihana. Piri gets a little local history from a kuia. Plus Piri and Richard pluck fresh water mussels from the river bed ahead of a whanau gathering.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S1 - EELS + DEER HUNTING + BREAKING IN HORSES
programme.desc: In this episode, Piri is in Masterton to try his hand at eeling. Plus two Martinborough locals take Piri deer hunting and show him how to break in a horse.

programme.title: The Streets S1 - Los Angeles
programme.desc: Los Angeles based electronic music producer and DJ Moe Espinosa, aka Drumcell, has created sonic soundscapes which tell cinematic stories with his music. Moe has always tried to avoid commercialism and by having a vision that remains independent.

programme.title: Car And Country Quest S1 - Ashique's Italy
programme.desc: Ashique surprises the team with Vespa rides along the coast, adapts plans with an aquarium visit, and arranges a Fiat 500 countryside drive. The day ends with relaxation at a Roman spa.

programme.title: Car And Country Quest S1 - Inside Ferrari
programme.desc: The trio are joined by Mathias Lauda, son of F1 Legend Niki Lauda, at Ferrari’s Maranello HQ. From factory tours showcasing Ferrari’s craftsmanship to dining in Ferrari’s historic restaurant, the team immerses in Ferrari’s legacy.

programme.title: Car And Country Quest S1 - Inside Ferrari 2
programme.desc: Freddie leads an exclusive Ferrari tour, as they explore Ferrari’s design centre, visit its museum, and honour F1 champions. A friendly race in the Ferrari simulator and a scenic drive in new Ferraris close their Italian adventure beautifully.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S6 - Taiwan: The Southern Tribes
programme.desc: Heading off the tourist trail in southern Taiwan, Jonathan embeds with the indigenous Paiwan tribe to uncover a hidden World War II story.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S6 - Season Special: Behind the Scenes
programme.desc: An exclusive look behind the scenes of the season, featuring memorable milestones and never-before-seen un-aired segments from the road.

programme.title: Travel with a Goat S1 - Donkey
programme.desc: Two foodies travel through Sicily with an animal. Will they decide to have the animal slaughtered after spending three days together with it?

programme.title: Travel with a Goat S1 - Pig
programme.desc: Two foodies travel through Thailand with an animal. Will they decide to have the animal slaughtered after spending three days together with it?

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - Panama
programme.desc: There is probably no country in the world that has more to do with world commerce than Panama. But Panama is more than just the canal—it’s a haven for wildlife.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - Gabon
programme.desc: Most of safari Africa is populated with the megafauna we see regularly on TV—lions, savannah elephants, Nile Crocodiles, Cape Buffalo to name a few. There is one area of the African rainforest where that isn’t the case.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - Dubai And Abu Dhabi
programme.desc: Bill has three quests—to go to the top of the tallest building in the world, to track rare desert wildlife especially the oryx, and to step back in time before the gleaming, ultra-modern skyscrapers when the locals lived a nomadic Bedouin lifestyle.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S1 - Estonia / Vietnam
programme.desc: In this episode, Josh travels to Tallinn in Estonia with urban explorer Steve Duncan where they explore Patarei Prison. Meanwhile, Cody is in Vietnam with his friend Sherman Mak and travels to Pan Thiet in search of abandoned amusement park Soui Cat.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S1 - Germany / Morocco
programme.desc: This time urban explorers Josh and Cody separately visit Germany and Morocco in search of astonishing abandoned locations including Wünsdorf, the forbidden city near Berlin, and an abandoned filmset in the Sahara desert used for Game of Thrones.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S1 - Georgia / France
programme.desc: Josh and Cody are separately visiting Georgia and France. Cody, together with rooftopper Harry Gallagher, undertakes a cable car trip known as 'Stalin’s coffin'. Josh is in France searching for abandoned chateaus with globetrotter Lexie Limitless.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S1 - WILD BOAR IN HEREKINO
programme.desc: In this episode, Piri is in Herekino where he meets local characters, brothers, Chad and Theo who take him on an epic pig hunting adventure.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S1 - DIVING FOR KINA AT RANGIPUTA
programme.desc: In this episode, Piri Weeps heads North to Rangiputa. Guided by locals Wikatana and Sandy, the trio hit the water for a kina dive. Plus Piri gains some insight on a rahui established in Ahipara.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S1 - TROUT FISHING THE TONGARIRO
programme.desc: In this episode, Piri heads to Turangi to go fly fishing on upper reaches of the Tongariro River only accessible by white water rafting.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S2 - Darwin Beer Can Regatta
programme.desc: Chris meets crocodiles, flies in a float planes and takes part in the famous Darwin Beer Can Regatta, all in Australia’s iconic Top End.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S3 - Bond, James Bond
programme.desc: Chris goes on the celebrity trail in LA , explores a mysterious ocean outcrop in his quest to become James Bond, visits a wildlife forest in the heart of Dublin, and has a close encounter with beautiful Fijian.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S3 - Fiji
programme.desc: Chris joins a rugby game in Fiji where kids are the stars, tests himself against the fittest men and women in the land of the body beautiful, has his heart stolen by a giant steer, and meets some cute Australian natives.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S1 - Racing a Million Devotees
programme.desc: Jonathan gets the classic train experience acclimating to bizarre washroom customs and the diversity of society rolling down the tracks. Glory, salvation and madness ensue when the master of the universe emerges from his temple.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S1 - Cruising the City of Joy
programme.desc: Our host dives deep into the rich stew of colonial legacies and neighborhood traditions

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S1 - Delhi to Manali
programme.desc: On the verge of an epic roadtrip, Jonathan visits the shrine of the motorcycle God for providence and sidetracks to combat the all-woman unit of the Delhi police.

programme.title: Epic Trails S2 - Jämtland, Sweden
programme.desc: Eric Hanson heads 63 degrees north to Jämtland, Sweden, where he discovers a wild culture and breathtaking wilderness trails.

programme.title: Epic Trails S2 - Wales
programme.desc: Eric Hanson heads to the UK to explore the rugged Wales Coast Path—an 870-mile hiking trail that offers stunning views and adventure along one of the most dramatic coastlines in the world.

programme.title: Epic Trails S2 - Newfoundland And Labrador, Canada
programme.desc: Eric Hanson travels to the far eastern edge of North America to discover the beauty of Newfoundland and explore the stunning East Coast Trail.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - The Valley of Desolation
programme.desc: Xander and his team travel to Graaff-Reinet, one of the oldest towns in South Africa, to enjoy food, history, and nature, while Adam spends the day searching for fossils in his hometown.

programme.title: Miguel's Feasts S1 - Mussels and Dinner Party Challenges
programme.desc: Miguel explores New Zealand mussels, tackles a seafood challenge, and cooks a dinner party menu tailored to diverse guest diets.

programme.title: Miguel's Feasts S1 - Street Food and Chocolate
programme.desc: Miguel tries food truck street eats, brews a simple pumpkin soup, and transforms cocoa beans into a five-star chocolate dessert.

programme.title: Roads Unknown India S1 - A Rough Ride
programme.desc: Jess and her riders face challenges heading to Kodaikanal, forced to confront landslides, ride through rough terrain and make decisions on the fly. Crossing into Kerala and reaching the iconic tea fields, the gang is rewarded with an elephant sighting and a new addition to their ride crew in Munnar.

programme.title: Roads Unknown India S1 - New Crew
programme.desc: Jess sets off for Palakkad, exploring the region’s lush tea plantations and local tribal villages. As the crew heads into Karnataka, they visit a stunning waterfall and gain more riders along the way. As they continue toward Thirthahalli, Jess receives a phone call that could change everything for her and the group.

programme.title: Andy And Ben Eat Australia S2 - A to B: Africola + Adelaide to the Barossa
programme.desc: Andy cooks with Duncan Welgemoed at Africola, visits Udder Delights, then heads to Jacob's Creek to blend wine and create the perfect grazing board.

programme.title: Andy And Ben Eat Australia S2 - Clare And The Lamb
programme.desc: Andy explores the Clare Valley with chef Dan Moss,visits local mushroom,grain and lamb producers,then cooks smoky lamb ribs paired with regional wine.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S1 - Classic Homes Are Timeless
programme.desc: Many people enjoy staying busy And always having a project on the go. Inez’s client loves to build And create breathtaking properties.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S1 - Agents of Million Dollar Homes
programme.desc: Deborah And Vezi are an international couple that want to live in Toronto for one year but has no idea where to start looking. Luckily for them Mike, Jin, Daryl, And Inez have teamed up to find them the home of their dreams.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S1 - Prince Edward Island
programme.desc: Michael hunts for PEI’s lost railway but finds joy in a potato museum, deep-sea fishing, a rotating house, and Mi’kmaq cultural traditions.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S1 - Quebec
programme.desc: Michael explores a Quebecois island by ferry, joins the Canadian Coast Guard behind the scenes, and visits a museum to see the future of rail.

programme.title: The Streets S1 - Detroit
programme.desc: Punk rocker Jon-Mikal formed his band The Idiot Kids as a way to deal with his sexuality. After coming out to his family at 21, he uses writing and his stage performance as a form of therapy.

programme.title: Chasing Monsters: El Nino S1 - Big Wave World Tour
programme.desc: Trevor Carlson puts everything on the line to chase monster waves from Maui, Hawaii to Ensenada, Mexico.

programme.title: Chasing Monsters: El Nino S1 - Skimboarding Jaws
programme.desc: Brad Domke aims for the big wave surfing history books by skimming the big waves of Pe’ahi.

programme.title: Chasing Monsters: El Nino S1 - Pe’ahi
programme.desc: Will Skudin and Keali’i Mamala deal with the trials and tribulations of life as traveling big wave surfers.

programme.title: My Van Life S1 - North Carolina
programme.desc: Meet Lisa, a former lawyer who escaped the rat race and moved into a campervan after the early death of her mother. Lisa embarks on a cross-country road trip, peeking inside homes on wheels, and connecting with the incredible community of nomads.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Claudia och Robin kämpar för att hitta ett nytt jadeblock innan deras köpare backar ur affären, men tiden och alternativen börjar sina.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Claudia vänder sig till sin pappa Steve för att få hjälp i rädslan av att den största försäljningen i hennes gruvkarriär håller på att glida henne mellan fingrarna.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Stämningen kokar över mellan Claudia, Robin och Josh när de gör ett sista försök att sluta en affär med en köpare från Vietnam.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Att flytta en massiv jadeskiva frestar på gruvans gamla utrustning och Joshs tålamod.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Att dra ett 20 tons stenblock på den förrädiska vägen ut ur gruvan visar sig vara för mycket för deras gamla lastbil Six Pack.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Robin hittar en massiv jadeskiva på Two Mile, men den riskerar att vara för stor för deras lilla operation för att kunna grävas fram.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: När en oväntad snöstorm i augusti strandar Claudia och Robin vid Two Mile, försöker Gary och Garon rädda dagen och de kör igenom stormen för att skaffa förnödenheter.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Robin fattar ett svårt beslut angående sin älskade gruvbil Six Pack efter ännu ett dyrt haveri.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Med den annalkande vintern pressar Claudia sin utmattade besättning till bristningsgränsen, vilket frestar på humöret och tvingar Claudia att till slut ta en för laget.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Den nya gruvsäsongen är full av otäcka överraskningar men en osannolik räddning räddar dagen.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Josh är trött på att jobba för sin pappa och startar sitt eget lastbilsföretag med en ny semi.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Armélastbilen dör på den brutala vägen till gruvan.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Gary och son räddar en gammal armélastbil men körningen upp till gruvan är brutal.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Garon och Josh tappar kontrollen över Six Pack på de leriga stigarna.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Justin flyger in med en ny trådsåg men förlorar tålamodet när han ska försöka sätta upp den.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Teamet stöter på oändligt med problem när de försöker kapa ut en bit av 60-fotsskivan.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Claudia tar in en stor borrutrustning och har bara fyra dagar på sig att hitta den bästa jaden, men hon och Robin kan inte bestämma var de ska leta.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Pojkarna bråkar samtidigt som en sen säsongsstart tvingar dem att arbeta i två gruvor samtidigt.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Om de lyckas hitta en ådra - vinner alla; om de misslyckas - drabbar detta hela staden.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: När Claudia och Robin provborrar efter jade och inte hittar något, kan inte ens företagets geologer skapa en gemensam plan.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Claudia, Robin och teamet kämpar för att få upp sin tunga utrustning upp på ett berg innan stigande floder gör det omöjligt att ta sig till gruvområdet.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Spänningarna växer när teamet kämpar för att få den tunga utrustningen uppför en lerig, stenig 120 km lång stig för projektet att skapa ett nytt jadebrott uppe på en bergstopp.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Teamet kämpar för att ta sina maskiner över kraftiga floder för att skapa sin nya bergstoppsbelägna jadegruva.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Alan är övertygad om att det finns jade under en vattenfylld grop på deras territorium Dynasty.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Robin kämpar mot fysikens lagar för att se till att få ett enormt nytt boendehus för deras nya territorium Wolverine.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Jade City-teamet förföljs av stor otur och alla kommer på unika lösningar för att försöka jaga bort demonerna.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Alla blir upprymda när de äntligen börjar gräva upp utlovande gröna stenblock som besättningen tror är värda miljoner.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Spänningarna kokar över när de utländska investerarna oväntat kommer förbi för att inspektera arbetet på gruvplatsen Wolverine och Alan försöker skipa fred.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: När de äntligen hittar några lovande stenblock vid Wolverinegruvan, upptäcker teamet att de kan ha brutit mot gruvdriftsreglerna.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Spänningen stiger när slutet av gruvsäsongen närmar sig och teamet i Jade City blir angelägna om att hitta det gäckande stenblocket värt miljontals dollar.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Minusgrader utmanar gruvarbetarna i Jade City som har bråttom för att hitta jackpotten - en jadesten som är tillräckligt stor för att imponera på investerarna - innan säsongen är slut.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Claudia och Robins oprövade maskiner börjar gå sönder på den brutala färden upp till Wolverine-gruvan.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Teamet försöker korsa forsande floder under sin marsch med sina maskiner upp till gruvan, men Josh hamnar på efterkälken i sin problembenägna grävmaskin.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Josh blir strandsatt på den långa leden till Wolverine-gruvan när bultar skakas loss från hans grävmaskin, och han kan inte ringa efter hjälp.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Gruvsäsongen börjar och medan jaden visar sig svårhittad, förvandlas en lastbilsolycka till en lönsam händelse för Jade City.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Guy blir ansvarig för Wolverine, där upplärningen av en ny arbetare hotar att stå i vägen för hans uppdrag att hitta säsongens första jade.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Precis när teamet på Wolverine skärper sina säkerhetsrutiner kollapsar den nya arbetaren Jay, vilket exponerar sprickorna i deras nödberedskap.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Josh blir strandsatt i den nya grävmaskinen samtidigt som ett lager av värdelösa stenar gör att Claudia börjar överväga en ny gruvstrategi.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Alan tar med sig en grupp köpare till Jade City vilket skapar panikläge i Claudias team för att hitta säsongens första säljbara jadeblock.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Medan besättningen kämpar sig genom lera för att hitta ett stenblock som är värt en miljon dollar, riskerar Josh att förlora utrustning för halv miljon dollar när han försöker dra upp sin lastbil ur ett slukhål.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Teamet hittar säsongens bästa jadeblock, men riskerar att minska dess värde när de försöker kapa bort alla frakturer.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Claudias son Justin visar att han har en näsa för jade, medan Scrappy Larry, Robin och Josh kämpar för att bogsera sin trasiga lastbil upp från spåret till Wolverine.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: En körning av tillhörigheter tvingar ut Robin och Justin på ett sista försök att leta efter jadestenar för att rädda säsongen medan Scrappy Larry har bråttom för att få en dieseltank ombyggd.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Claudias satsning på att driva en arbetsgrupp i Jade City hotas när septiktanken backar in i deras dricksvatten.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Med tidig ankomst av det kalla vädret och med skulder som hopar sig, knuffar, släpar och skjuter besättningen på en maffig och potentiellt säsongsvinnande sten till lägret.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Med årets mest lovande stenblock under sågen på Wolverine, kör Josh och R2 i diket med sin lastbil, vilket även drabbar Claudia och teamet.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Loppet pågår för att ta sig bort från Wolverine-lägret innan snön täcker allt.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Claudia blir tvungen att köra stenbilen när hennes besättning kämpar sig uppför den steniga stigen till deras bergstoppsbelägna jadeläger, Wolverine

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Spänningarna kulminerar när Claudia, Robin och teamet försöker transportera människor och utrustning till det avlägsna jadelägret.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Claudia och Robin försöker imponera på sina nya affärspartners men de första dagarna på deras nya område, Bullion Creek, är krävande.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Säsongens första stora stenblock transporteras tillbaka till lägret och sätts under sågen.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Justin skyndar sig för att inmuta ett område efter att han snubblat över ett fantastiskt jadefynd, men andra gruvarbetare närmar sig.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Claudias nya partnerskap blir lidande när Justin och teamet distraheras av att försöka flytta ett gigantiskt stenblock som kan vara värt en förmögenhet.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE

programme.title: Magnum
programme.desc: Der Country-Musiker Lacy beauftragt Magnum, Notenblätter von fünf verlorengegangenen Songs des in den 50-iger Jahren verstorbenen Country-Sängers George Lee Jessup wiederzubeschaffen. Der Detektiv erfährt bei seinen Ermittlungen, dass George diese Lieder seiner damaligen Liebe Laurie gewidmet hatte. Kurze Zeit später gelingt es Magnum und Lacy, Laurie ausfindig zu machen. Diese gesteht beiden, dass sie nach Jessups Tod die Notenblätter an sich genommen hatte. Nach einigem Zögern ist sie bereit, Magnum und Lacy die Papiere auzuhändigen. Aber Magnums Freude ist nicht von langer Dauer. Denn der Plattenproduzent Billy, der ebenfalls schon lange hinter Jessups Werk ist, nimmt Magnum die Notenblätter wieder ab. Außerdem werden Magnums weitere Ermittlungen von Lauries plötzlichen Selbstmord überschattet.

programme.title: MacGyver
programme.desc: In Umbrien wurde ein sehr wertvolles Fahrzeug zu einem Schnäppchenpreis zum Verkauf angeboten. Erste Hinweise deuten darauf hin, dass der Wagen Franco Scuro gehören könnte, einstiger Kopf einer Mafia-Familie und Nummer 5 auf der Interpol-Liste der meistgesuchten Verbrecher. Desi und Mac fliegen nach Italien, um der Spur zu folgen. Können sie Scuro, der bereits seit 15 Jahren untergetaucht ist, endlich dingfest machen?

programme.title: FBI: Special Crime Unit
programme.desc: Die Ermittler in New York arbeiten mit Hochdruck daran, einen Serienkiller zu schnappen, der es auf junge Frauen abgesehen hat. Mit Chrissy Bugasi hat der Täter bereits das dritte Opfer auf dem Gewissen, das er erdrosselt und im Nachgang ungewöhnlich geschminkt hat, um es irgendwo draußen zu platzieren. Das FBI stellt dank eines Bekennerschreibens schnell fest, dass sie es hier mit einem Narzissten zu tun haben, der sich selbst als Apex, das Alpha-Raubtier, bezeichnet ...

programme.title: Monk
programme.desc: In einer Tiefgarage hat Sharona eine unheimliche Begegnung: Ein schwer verwundeter Mann torkelt auf sie zu. Er kennt sie offenbar, und teilt ihr mit, Douglas mache sich Sorgen um sie - Douglas ist Sharonas verstorbener Vater. Das Team von Captain Stottlemeyer findet in der Garage jedoch keine Spuren des Mannes. Doch es bleibt nicht das letzte Mal, dass der Unbekannte Sharona eine Botschaft überbringt. Mr. Monk sorgt sich um seine Assistentin, die fürchtet, verrückt zu werden.

programme.title: Monk
programme.desc: In der Lagerhalle eines Supermarktes stirbt die Verkäuferin Edna Coruthers - ganz offenbar ein Arbeitsunfall. Erst nach einem Monat kommen Mr. Monk Zweifel: Joe Christie, der Sicherheitsmann des Marktes und ein alter Partner von Monk, hat den Verdacht, dass Edna ermordet wurde. Christie heuert seinen ehemaligen Kollegen als Mitarbeiter an, und der pingelige Detektiv mausert sich bald zum besten Angestellten des Ladens. Nebenbei ermittelt er in dem möglichen Mordfall ...

programme.title: Hawaii Five-0
programme.desc: Honolulu wird von einer extremen Hitzewelle geplagt, was erfahrungsgemäß die Aggressivität der Menschen steigen lässt. So auch bei Tracy Benson, die wegen einer defekten Klimaanlage ihren Vermieter krankenhausreif geprügelt hat. Als sie festgenommen wird, gelingt es ihr, sich zu befreien und zwei Polizisten dabei zu erschießen. Das Team ist über das Ausmaß der Gewalt bestürzt, denn Tracy war bis jetzt ein unbescholtenes Blatt. Doch bald stellt sich heraus, dass sie unter einer falschen Identität gelebt hat.

programme.title: MacGyver
programme.desc: Ein Pharmaunternehmen wird verdächtigt, mit dem Vermittler der Nano-Tracker unter einem Hut zu stecken. Kam es aufgrund dieser Zusammenarbeit tatsächlich zur Entwicklung der gefährlichen Technologie, die es schafft, Nervensignale zu blockieren? In Begleitung von Desi erweisen unterdessen Mac und Bozer ihrer Tante die letzte Ehre. Doch schon bald kommen erste Zweifel auf: Starb sie tatsächlich eines natürlichen Todes?

programme.title: FBI: Special Crime Unit
programme.desc: Ein Familienhaus fliegt aufgrund einer deponierten Bombe in die Luft. Schnell stellt sich heraus, dass es sich um eine Verschleierungsaktion handelte, denn im Inneren finden die Beamten die Leichen von Connie Gilman und ihren beiden Kindern, die offensichtlich ermordet wurden. Vom Familienvater Thomas Gilman fehlt unterdessen jede Spur. Der Mann ist dringend tatverdächtigt und soll umgehend auf die Most Wanted-Liste gesetzt werden ...

programme.title: The Mentalist
programme.desc: Carl Ward, der Ehemann der wohlhabenden Esther Doverton, wird verletzt ins Krankenhaus eingeliefert, nachdem er nachts Safeknacker überrascht hatte. Eine Fährte des CBI-Teams führt zu Gangster Donny Culpepper. Patrick arrangiert daraufhin eine zufällige Begegnung zwischen Culpepper und Doverton sowie ihren Söhnen Tom und George, die ergibt, dass Culpepper unschuldig ist. Um den Täter endgültig dingfest zu machen, stellt Patrick dem zweiten Hauptverdächtigen eine geniale Falle ...

programme.title: The Mentalist
programme.desc: Barney Sloop, Begründer der Sloop-Baseball-Akademie, wird ermordet aufgefunden. Er machte junge Talente ausfindig, ließ sie an der Akademie ausbilden und verkaufte sie dann an Vereine. Der Mord geschah in der Nacht vor der Präsentation der Talente, zu der Spieler-Scouts erwartet wurden. Zunächst gerät Barneys Frau Leslie in Verdacht, da sie nun seine hohe Lebensversicherung einstreichen kann. Doch schnell merkt Patrick, dass es hier um mehr geht, als um Geld ...

programme.title: Monk
programme.desc: Trudys Vater bittet Monk, nach L.A. zu kommen, wo er eine Gameshow produziert. Denn er braucht Monks Hilfe, weil er einen auffällig erfolgreichen Kandidaten des Betrugs verdächtigt.Da Monk seinem Schwiegervater nichts abschlagen kann, überwindet er sich und reist ins Fernsehstudio nach Hollywood. Da er keine andere Möglichkeit sieht, den Fall aufzuklären, nimmt er selbst als Kandidat an der Show teil und findet bald erstaunliche Dinge heraus.

programme.title: Kabel Eins :newstime
programme.desc: Nachrichten live aus München: Die Kabel Eins :newstime informiert die Zuschauer:innen über die wichtigsten Themen des Tages aus Politik, Wirtschaft, Sport und Gesellschaft. Angela van Brakel und Norbert Anwander moderieren die Nachrichtensendung im Wechsel.

programme.title: Monk
programme.desc: Mr. Monk beschließt endlich, ein Medikament gegen seine Neurosen auszuprobieren. Als Captain Stottlemeyer bei einem Einsatz angeschossen wird - mit der Waffe einer Frau, die kurz zuvor in der Nähe Selbstmord beging - soll der Detektiv ermitteln, doch seine Kollegen erkennen den einst so genialen, pingeligen Mann nicht wieder. Er scheint seinen unvergleichlichen Spürsinn verloren zu haben, stattdessen legt er ein ganz neues Selbstbewusstsein und nie gekannte Lässigkeit an den Tag.

programme.title: Abenteuer Leben täglich
programme.desc: Heimwerker Michél Claußen träumt vom warmen Gartenbad - und will sich einen eigenen Hot Tub zusammenzimmern. Eine alte Zinkwanne, eine Kupferspirale und ein Holzfeuer sollen für wohlige Wärme sorgen. Doch störrische Rohre und tropfende Anschlüsse machen das Projekt zur Geduldsprobe.

programme.title: Mein Lokal, Dein Lokal
programme.desc: Inmitten der Kleinstadt Hennef (Sieg) möchte Joubran seinen Mitstreitern zur Eröffnung der Woche die mexikanische Küche schmackhaft machen. Der Geschäftsführer vom El Loco Mexicano versucht hierbei vor allem mit feuriger Küche vom Grill zu überzeugen. Schafft Joubran es, seinen Mitstreitern so richtig einzuheizen?

programme.title: Achtung Kontrolle
programme.desc: Döner-Experte Can F. Kennedy aus Berlin hat sich vorgenommen, den besten Döner Hamburgs zu finden. Erster Stopp: der Familienbetrieb Spießano - hier gibt es Döner mit Trüffel-Parmesan-Soße. Can hat klare Regeln: frisches Fleisch und knackiger Salat. Besteht der Laden seine Prüfung?

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: Der Undercover-Cop Kimble jagt seit Jahren vergeblich den Drogenbaron und Killer Crisp. Kimbles letzte Chance: Er muss dessen Frau Joyce, die sich in Oregon vor ihrem Mann versteckt, ausfindig machen. Um das zu schaffen, stellt sich Kimble - wenig begeistert - als neuer Lehrer an der Vorschule ihres Sohnes vor. Mit neunmalklugen Sprüchen, schwachen Blasen und jeder Menge Lärm tanzen die Bälger ihm auf der Nase herum. Und dann taucht ganz unerwartet auch noch Crisp auf ...

programme.title: Beverly Hills Cop II
programme.desc: Schlechte Nachrichten aus Beverly Hills: Axel Foleys Freund Captain Bogomil ist auf der Straße angeschossen worden und Axel fliegt sofort an die Westküste, um bei der Suche nach Tätern zu helfen. Die Spuren deuten auf einen Verbrecherring, der die Stadt seit Tagen mit schweren Raubüberfällen in Atem hält. Während die Ärzte um Bogomils Leben kämpfen, nimmt Axel mit Taggart und Rosewood die Suche nach dem Schützen auf. Ihre Ermittlungen führen bald zu dem skrupellosen Waffenhändler Maxwell Dent und seiner Killer-Lady Karla. Dummerweise identifizieren die beiden Axel schnell als Cop und setzen einen Killer auf ihn an. Mit wenig Erfolg allerdings, denn der reaktionsschnelle und clevere Foley hat einen unschlagbaren Instinkt für gefährliche Situationen…

programme.title: Beverly Hills Cop III
programme.desc: Eine Razzia in einer Autowerkstatt geht gründlich daneben. Axel Foleys Vorgesetzter wird getötet, die Gangster können entkommen. Eine Spur führt Foley nach Beverly Hills, Schauplatz seiner letzten spektakulären Erfolge.

programme.title: Race for Glory: Audi vs. Lancia
programme.desc: Motorsport-Drama nach wahrer Begebenheit: Bei der Rallye-Weltmeisterschaft 1983 entbrennt ein erbitterter Kampf zwischen Lancia und Audi. Italienische Erfahrung trifft auf deutsche Spitzentechnologie. Doch das wahre Duell findet abseits der Piste statt: Teamchef Roland Gumpert und sein Rivale Cesare Fiorio verstricken sich in ein gefährliches Netz aus Intrigen, bei dem es für beide längst um mehr als nur den Sieg geht.

programme.title: Magnum
programme.desc: Mrs. Jones bittet Magnum, ihren Mann Ray zu suchen. Sie ist davon überzeugt, dass sich der gefragte Computerspezialist, der kürzlich eine wichtige Entdeckung gemacht hat, in Gefahr befindet. Seine spezielle Formel über die Entwicklung von künstlicher Intelligenz könnte, wenn sie in falsche Hände geriete, einen unermesslichen Schaden anrichten. Erst als Higgins Mrs. Jones hypnotisiert, kommen Magnum und er der Lösung des Falles näher.
